payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends share one story book. They sit close on the mat. They turn each page together out in the playground.

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, a friend cannot do up his buttons. His friend helps him do them. He buttons the shirt to the top.

payload.title: Diwali feels safe and warm

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, a friend cannot find his shoe. His friend looks under the bench. He finds it and gives it back.

payload.title: We share gifts on Diwali

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, the class has a drawing lesson today. Priya draws a big yellow sun. She colours it and shows it to her friend.

payload.passage: Hari helped his sister tidy the toy shelf. They lined up the cars in a neat row. The soft toys sat on top, and the books stood up straight below.

payload.title: Lakshmi keeps the class jobs list

payload.passage: While they play together, a friend forgets her crayon box. Two girls share theirs with her. Now she can colour her page.

payload.title: Disha helps pack the bags

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls share one new pen. They write on the same page. They take turns very nicely during the lunch break.

payload.passage: The bright morning sun woke the whole street. Akash opened the window wide. Warm light filled his room, and a koel sang loudly from the mango tree outside.
payload.title: A bright sunny morning

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, a friend cannot find his class line. His friend waves to him. He runs over and joins the line.
payload.title: A friend waves a lost boy over

payload.passage: Krish helped sweep the leaves in the yard. They had fallen all over from the big tree. He raked them into a tidy pile and put them in the bin.
payload.title: Krish rakes the fallen leaves
decoys: The leaves fell from the tree

payload.passage: Frogs live near a cool green pond. They can jump up very high and very far with their back legs. They catch buzzing flies with their long sticky tongue.
payload.title: Frogs live near the pond

payload.passage: A rainbow is an arch with many bright colours. It comes out in the sky after the rain has stopped. Red, yellow and blue all shine together up high.
payload.title: A rainbow has many colours

payload.passage: Anu went to a new dance studio. The walls were full of mirrors. She made a friend in the front row, and they practised twirls together in front of the glass.
payload.title: Anu makes a friend at the studio

payload.passage: After the first bell, Pari draws a cloud and rain. She makes the rain drops fall. She adds a small umbrella below.
payload.title: Pari draws a rainy day

payload.passage: Some frogs have very bright and colourful skin. These bright colours warn other animals to keep away. They tell the other animals that the frog is not safe to eat.
payload.title: Bright frogs warn other animals

payload.passage: Sameer went to the market to buy a torchlight bulb. The tiny bulbs sat in a box. He picked the one that fit his torch and it glowed bright.
payload.title: Sameer buys a torch bulb

payload.passage: Tigers are big and strong wild cats. They have bright orange fur with black stripes all over the body. They quietly hunt for their food in the thick green forest.
payload.title: Tigers are big wild cats

payload.passage: Rahul helped his father carry firewood for the stove. They made a small stack by the door. Rahul brought the smaller pieces, two at a time, in his arms.
payload.title: Rahul carries the firewood
decoys: They stacked it by the door
He carried two at a time

payload.passage: Lakshmi helped wash the steel plates after the party. There was a big pile. She and her cousin took turns, and soon every plate sat sparkling on the rack.
payload.title: They wash the party plates

payload.passage: During the school hours, Bittu brings a kite to the school fair. It is shaped like a bird. He flies it high in the open sky.
payload.title: Bittu flies a kite
decoys: The kite is a bird shape
It is at the school fair

payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends share one box of sweets. They count them out fair. Each one gets the same number.
payload.title: Friends share sweets fairly

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, a friend cannot tie her plait. Her friend braids it for her. She ties a band at the end.
payload.title: A friend braids her hair

payload.passage: Saanvi helped tidy the shoe rack at the door. Shoes were lying all over. She paired each one and lined them up neatly from big to small.
payload.title: Saanvi tidies the shoe rack

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, a friend cannot find his way home. His friend walks with him. He shows him the right road.
payload.title: A friend shows the way home

payload.passage: A new boy sat alone at lunch. Tejas walked over and sat beside him. He shared his fruit, asked his name, and they laughed about a silly joke.
payload.title: Tejas sits with a lonely boy

payload.passage: Roots are the part of a plant that grow under ground. They hold the whole plant firmly in its place. They also drink up water from the soil for the plant.
payload.title: Roots hold the plant

payload.passage: During the lunch break, a friend is new and feels lost. Two girls take his hand. They show him the whole school.
payload.title: Friends show a new boy around

payload.passage: Ants are very tiny insects but they are strong. They can carry bits of food that are much bigger than them. They all live together in a busy ant hill.
payload.title: Ants are tiny but strong

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, two girls each have half a chalk. They put them in one box. Now the whole class can use the chalk.
payload.title: Friends share their chalk

payload.passage: Diya went to the bookshop with her teacher. Shelves of books rose high to the roof. Diya found a story about a brave lion and could not stop smiling.
payload.title: Diya finds a lion story
decoys: The book was about a lion

payload.passage: During the lunch break, Tia brings a basket of plums. She sets it down at break. She shares them with the group.
payload.title: Tia shares her plums

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we forgive other people. We happily let go of any old fights. Then we smile at them and move on together.
payload.title: On Eid we forgive others

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, Vihaan keeps his shoes shiny. He wipes them with a soft cloth. He lines them up by the wall.
payload.title: Vihaan keeps his shoes shiny
decoys: They line up by the wall

payload.passage: A boy named Ravina's cousin moved next door. Ravina knocked and said a warm hello. She showed him her swing, and they took turns until the sun went down.
payload.title: Ravina welcomes her new neighbour

payload.passage: Every festival is full of happy songs. People clap their hands along to the beat. They all sing the lovely songs together as one.
payload.title: A festival has happy songs

payload.passage: Dark clouds rolled in and the rain began. Meena and her brother ran under a big tree. They watched the drops fall and counted the loud claps of thunder.
payload.title: They shelter from the rain

payload.passage: Esha helped grandmother fold the saris. She held one end up high. Grandmother folded slowly, and together they stacked them neatly in the wooden almirah.
payload.title: Esha helps fold the clothes

payload.passage: Foxes are clever animals with a long bushy tail. They have soft fur that is red and brown in colour. They are quick on their feet and good at hiding.
payload.title: Foxes are clever animals

payload.passage: On Eid the new moon in the sky is special. People look up carefully into the evening sky. When they spot the thin moon, the festival begins.
payload.title: The moon starts the Eid festival

payload.passage: At the busy school, a friend cannot carry his heavy bag. His friend takes one strap. They carry it together with a big smile.
payload.title: Friends carry a heavy bag

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we sing happy songs. We hold hands and dance round in a big circle. We clap our hands along to the music.
payload.title: We sing happy songs on Pongal

payload.passage: A pearl is a smooth round bead that forms in a shell. It slowly grows bigger inside the shell of a sea animal. People take it out and make it into pretty jewels.
payload.title: A pearl forms inside a shell

payload.passage: Camels live in the hot and sandy desert. They can walk for many days without getting tired or thirsty. They store food and water in the big hump on their back.
payload.title: Camels live in the desert

payload.passage: Dogs make very good pets at home. They love to run fast and play with a ball in the park. They also bark loud to keep our home safe at night.
payload.title: Dogs make good pets

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Ruhi brings a fresh mango. She slices it on a plate. She shares it with her best friend.
payload.title: Ruhi shares her mango

payload.passage: Vanya and her father bought a fresh pineapple. It had a spiky green top. The seller chopped off the leaves and put the golden fruit into their bag.
payload.title: They buy a sweet pineapple

payload.passage: Ananya bught a soft scarf on a cold market day. The stall hung scarves in a row. She wrapped a warm red one around her neck and smiled.
payload.title: Ananya buys a warm scarf
decoys: The scarves hung in a row

payload.passage: Naina helped Amma make the morning juice. She dropped oranges into the machine. It whirred loudly, and out came sweet juice that filled three little glasses.
payload.title: Naina helps make the juice

payload.passage: Mira helped feed her baby brother. She held the small bowl steady. She gave him soft spoonfuls and wiped his chin when a little dribbled down.
payload.title: Mira feeds her baby brother

payload.passage: Reindeer are animals that live in very cold lands. They have big horns on the head that branch like a tree. They walk over the deep white snow to find food.
payload.title: Reindeer live in cold lands

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the class learns to plant in a row. They make small holes in the soil. They drop one seed in each hole.
payload.title: Planting seeds in a row

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Sohan sees a friend sitting alone. He goes and sits with him. Soon they laugh and play a game.
payload.title: Sohan sits with a lonely friend

payload.passage: Parth helped Appa buy a small bulb for the porch. The shop had many sizes. They chose a round bulb that gave a warm yellow glow at the front door.
payload.title: They buy a porch bulb

payload.passage: Early in the day, the class watches a puppet show today. The puppets are a cat and a mouse. The children laugh at their funny talk.
payload.title: A puppet show in class

payload.passage: Nikhil went to buy a kite reel for the windy season. The seller showed wooden and plastic ones. Nikhil chose a wooden reel that felt strong in his hand.
payload.title: Nikhil buys a kite reel

payload.passage: Soft white snow falls down in the cold winter. It covers the whole ground in a thick white blanket. Children love to play and make a snowman with it.
payload.title: Snow falls in winter

payload.passage: We feel lots of joy on festival days. We forget all our little worries for a while. We just smile and feel happy all day long.
payload.title: We feel joy at festivals

payload.passage: After the first bell, the children learn to fold a napkin. The teacher shows a neat square. Each child folds one on the desk.
payload.title: Learning to fold a napkin

payload.passage: Naveen went to buy a comb and a brush. The shop sold soaps and towels too. He picked a blue comb and a soft brush for his curly hair.
payload.title: Naveen buys a comb and brush

payload.passage: Roopa met a new friend at her cousin's birthday. They both liked drawing. They sat in a corner with paper and crayons and drew matching butterflies together.
payload.title: Roopa makes a friend at the party

payload.passage: We decorate the room with many balloons. They float up high and bump against the ceiling. The balloons come in lots of bright happy colours.
payload.title: We decorate with balloons

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, the children make a class calendar. They write the names of the months. They mark all the holidays in red.
payload.title: Making a class calendar

payload.passage: Goats are friendly animals that live on the farm. They eat soft green grass and the fresh leaves off the bushes. They love to climb up high rocks and small hills.
payload.title: Goats are friendly farm animals

payload.passage: Rain pattered all day, so Yuvan stayed at his window. He drew shapes in the fog. He made a happy face on the glass and watched it slowly disappear.
payload.title: Yuvan draws on the foggy glass

payload.passage: Dragonflies are insects with thin shiny wings. They fly very fast near the cool green pond. They have very big round eyes to help them see.
payload.title: Dragonflies fly near the pond

payload.passage: Nisha helped Amma make the salad. She washed the tomatoes and tore the lettuce. Then she squeezed a little lemon and gave it a gentle, careful toss.
payload.title: Nisha helps make the salad

payload.passage: A festival fills our hearts with lots of hope. We wish and pray for many good things. We feel happy and bright deep inside us.
payload.title: A festival fills us with hope

payload.passage: While they play together, two girls share one pot of glue. One sticks paper, one sticks string. They make one big card.
payload.title: Friends share the glue

payload.passage: Rain made the playground too wet for games. Avni and her friends drew pictures inside. They each drew a big umbrella with raindrops falling all around it.
payload.title: Drawing umbrellas on a rainy day

payload.passage: A girl named Ahana was new on the school van. Dhruvi made room beside her. They played a clapping game the whole way and waved bye at the gate.
payload.title: Dhruvi befriends Ahana on the van

payload.passage: Heavy rain flooded the little lane. Kabeer put on his boots and went out. He waded through and watched the brown water swirl quickly down into the open drain.
payload.title: Kabeer wades through the flooded lane

payload.passage: Sneha joined a new dance class. She felt shy at first. But a friendly girl held her hand, showed her the steps, and soon Sneha was dancing happily.
payload.title: Sneha settles into dance class

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, a friend trips and drops her bag. The others rush to help. They put all the books back inside.
payload.title: Friends help with a dropped bag

payload.passage: Imran and his mother bought groceries for the week. They filled two big bags with food. The autorickshaw took them and the bags safely back home.
payload.title: They buy groceries for the week

payload.passage: Aditi dusted the shelves in the living room. She wiped each photo frame with care. The room looked brighter, and the glass on every picture began to shine.
payload.title: Aditi dusts the shelves

payload.passage: It rained on the way to grandmother's house. Manoj counted the puddles from the car. By the time they arrived, he had counted thirty shiny pools of water.
payload.title: Counting puddles in the rain

payload.passage: Every festival is full of bright happy colours. We see the lovely colours all around us. The bright colours make us smile with joy.
payload.title: A festival has bright colours

payload.passage: We decorate a green tree for the big party. We hang shiny round balls all over its branches. The whole tree looks lovely and bright with lights.
payload.title: We decorate a tree for the party

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we wake up very early. We wash ourselves and put on nice clothes. Then we happily greet the special festive day.
payload.title: On Eid we wake up early

payload.passage: We put up colourful flags for a festival. The pretty flags wave gently in the wind. They make the whole street look bright and cheerful.
payload.title: We put up flags for festivals

payload.passage: While they play together, two girls share one packet of dots. They stick them on their cards. They make two pretty patterns.
payload.title: Friends share dot stickers

payload.passage: After the first bell, the teacher blows soap bubbles in class. The bubbles float up and pop. The children chase them with glee.
payload.title: Soap bubbles in class

payload.passage: On the Holi festival we wear our old clothes. We know the bright colours will stay on them. But we do not mind that one little bit.
payload.title: We wear old clothes on Holi

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, Charu brings a box of dates. She passes it to her friends. They each take one sweet date.
payload.title: Charu shares her dates

payload.passage: On the Holi festival the air smells very sweet. Tasty sweet treats are set out everywhere. We happily eat them while we play in the colours.
payload.title: The air smells sweet on Holi

payload.passage: Dev and his sister bought bread and milk from the corner shop. They paid the shopkeeper with coins. He gave them a small toffee as a treat.
payload.title: They buy bread and milk
decoys: The shop was at the corner

payload.passage: Big raindrops began to fall on the playground. Pooja and her friends rushed inside. They pressed their noses to the window and watched the rain dance on the swings.
payload.title: Rain ends the playground games

payload.passage: Naina went to a new toy library with her mother. She could borrow toys like books. She picked a wooden train and promised to bring it back next week.
payload.title: Naina visits the toy library

payload.passage: Early in the day, Eshan keeps his bag on the hook. He hangs it up every morning. He takes it down at home time.
payload.title: Eshan hangs up his bag
decoys: He takes it at home time

payload.passage: Snails are little animals that move very slowly. They carry a hard round shell on their back as a home. They leave a wet shiny trail behind them as they go.
payload.title: Snails move very slowly
decoys: The shell is on the back

payload.passage: Birds can fly high up in the open sky. They have two strong wings and a body covered in many soft feathers. They build small round nests in the tall trees.
payload.title: Birds can fly and build nests

payload.passage: Pigs are animals that live happily on the farm. They love to roll about in the cool wet mud all day. The soft mud keeps their body cool in the hot sun.
payload.title: Pigs live on the farm

payload.passage: During the school hours, Diya learns to draw a star. She makes five neat points. She colours it bright yellow with great care.
payload.title: Diya draws a star

payload.passage: We blow out the candles on our birthday cake. But first we close our eyes and make a special wish. Then everyone around us claps loudly for us.
payload.title: We blow out birthday candles

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, a friend cannot lift the water can. His friend holds the other side. Together they fill the pots.
payload.title: Friends lift the water can

payload.passage: Sameer helped wipe the muddy footprints off the floor. He filled a bucket with water. Then he mopped slowly until the whole floor was shiny and clean.
payload.title: Sameer mops the muddy floor

payload.passage: A festival fills the home with many lovely smells. Sweets and tasty food cook in the kitchen all day. The good smell makes all of us feel hungry.
payload.title: A festival fills the home with smells

payload.passage: Anu helped her father buy a basket of mangoes. The fruit seller let them taste one first. It was sweet, so they bought a full basket to share.
payload.title: They buy sweet mangoes

payload.passage: Mira went to the market to buy candles. The shop had thin and fat ones. She bought a fat white candle for the nights when the lights went off.
payload.title: Mira buys a candle for dark nights

payload.passage: A boy named Akash was new in the apartment. Pranav knocked and asked him to play. They rode their cycles round the block until the streetlights came on.
payload.title: Pranav welcomes the new boy

payload.passage: During the school hours, Tarun spills water on his desk. His friend gives him a cloth. Together they wipe the desk clean.
payload.title: Friends clean a spill

payload.passage: Nivaan went to the market to buy a whistle. The toy stall had loud ones. He chose a silver whistle and gave it one blow that made everyone turn around.
payload.title: Nivaan buys a loud whistle

payload.passage: We clean up the whole house for Diwali. We make pretty colourful patterns near the front door. By the end the whole home looks fresh and bright.
payload.title: We clean our home for Diwali

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, Vikram has a big umbrella. His friend has none in the rain. Vikram shares his umbrella on the way home.
payload.title: Vikram shares his umbrella

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Sneha bakes some cookies at home. She brings them to school. She gives one to each of her friends.
payload.title: Sneha shares her cookies

payload.passage: Horses are tall animals that are very strong. They can run very fast on their four long thin legs. People sit and ride on the back of a horse.
payload.title: Horses are tall and strong

payload.passage: Early in the day, the music teacher comes to class. She plays a happy tune. All the children sing along together before the next class.
payload.title: The class sings a song

payload.passage: After the first bell, the class learns about the sun and moon. The teacher shows a big bright sun. She says the moon comes at night.
payload.title: Learning about the sun and moon

payload.passage: Out in the playground, two friends share one bag of chalk dust. They clap the dusters together. They watch the dust fly up.
payload.title: Friends clap the dusters

payload.passage: Out in the playground, a friend cannot reach the tap. His friend turns it on for him. He cups his hands and drinks.
payload.title: A friend helps at the tap

payload.passage: Deepa bought a clay pot from the potter's stall. Rows of brown pots stood in the sun to dry. She chose a small one to plant a tulsi seed.
payload.title: Deepa buys a clay pot

payload.passage: On the Holi festival we eat many sweets. We happily share the tasty sweets with everyone. We feel very happy and full at the end.
payload.title: We share sweets on Holi

payload.passage: A wedding is a big and happy party for two people. The two people stand together and get married. Everyone who comes wears their brightest, finest clothes.
payload.title: A wedding is a big party

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, the teacher shows a soft cotton ball. She lets the children feel it. They learn that cotton is very light.
payload.title: Feeling soft cotton in class

payload.passage: Termites are tiny insects that build tall mounds. They use bits of wet mud to build them up high. Many thousands of termites live inside the big mound.
payload.title: Termites build tall mounds

payload.passage: Mishka helped grandmother wind the wool. The big tangle slowly grew smaller. Mishka wound it round her hands until a tidy ball sat in the basket.
payload.title: Mishka winds the wool
decoys: She wound it round her hands

payload.passage: Acorns are little brown nuts that grow on oak trees. Busy squirrels gather up many of them in autumn. They store the acorns to eat in the cold winter.
payload.title: Acorns grow on oak trees

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the children plant a tiny seed in a pot. They add soil and water it. They hope a plant will grow soon.
payload.title: The class plants a seed

payload.passage: We give thanks for our food at harvest time. We feel very glad and lucky to have it. We happily share the food with everyone around us.
payload.title: We give thanks at the harvest

payload.passage: Devraj helped Amma carry the water pots. He took the lighter one. He walked slowly and steadily so not a single drop would spill on the clean floor.
payload.title: Devraj carries the water pots

payload.passage: Yash visited a new ice cream parlour. There were many flavours behind the glass. He chose mango, and his new friend chose chocolate, and they swapped one spoonful each.
payload.title: Yash visits the ice cream parlour

payload.passage: The morning sun warmed the open terrace. Geeta helped hang the wet clothes to dry. The bright light dried them fast while the cool wind made them flap.
payload.title: Drying clothes in the sun

payload.passage: Deepa started at a new school today. A kind girl named Mira sat beside her. Mira told her where the library was and shared her box of crayons.
payload.title: Deepa's first day at a new school

payload.passage: A girl named Tisha sat alone in the new class. Aadhya moved to sit beside her. She shared her crayons and asked Tisha to draw a picture together.
payload.title: Aadhya sits with a new girl

payload.passage: Amrita and her father bought a watermelon. The seller tapped it to show it was ripe. They rolled the round green melon into their bag and went home.
payload.title: They buy a ripe watermelon
decoys: They put it in a bag

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, Tej brings a fresh guava. He cuts it into slices. He shares the slices with his friends without any fuss.
payload.title: Tej shares his guava

payload.passage: Cows give us fresh white milk every single day. They stand in the green field and eat soft grass all day long. We drink their milk to grow big and strong.
payload.title: Cows give us milk

payload.passage: Hriday helped his grandfather sweep the temple steps. He used a soft broom. He cleared each step from top to bottom until the whole flight looked spotless.
payload.title: Hriday sweeps the temple steps

payload.passage: After the first bell, it is time for the maths lesson. The teacher counts ten red apples on the board. The children count along with her.
payload.title: Counting in the maths lesson

payload.passage: Disha and her mother bought fresh peas. The pods were green and full. At home they sat together and popped the peas out into a steel bowl.
payload.title: They buy fresh green peas

payload.passage: Veer went to the market to buy a new ball-pen. The cup on the counter held many pens. He tested one on paper and bought the smooth blue pen.
payload.title: Veer buys a smooth blue pen

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, Heena brings a juicy orange. She splits it into parts. She gives a piece to each friend.
payload.title: Heena shares her orange

payload.passage: A joey is the tiny baby of a kangaroo. It is very small and weak when it is first born. It stays safe and warm inside its mother's pouch.
payload.title: A baby kangaroo is a joey
decoys: The joey stays in a pouch

payload.passage: Avni met a new friend at the dance fair. They both wore bright yellow. They giggled at being twins and held hands as they watched the colourful show.
payload.title: Avni meets a twin friend

payload.passage: The bright sun made the temple pond sparkle. Amrita and her grandmother fed the fish there. The golden fish came to the top to nibble the soft bread.
payload.title: Feeding fish on a sunny day

payload.passage: Ved went to a new science park with his class. He spun a giant wheel that made sparks. He pressed a button, and a tall fountain shot up in colours.
payload.title: Ved visits the science park

payload.passage: During their free time, Gita has a bag of popcorn. She brings it to the playground. She shares it with all her friends.
payload.title: Gita shares her popcorn

payload.passage: Rain hammered on the tin roof at night. Vanya counted each loud clap of thunder. She felt safe under her quilt and soon fell into a deep, cosy sleep.
payload.title: A loud, rainy night

payload.passage: Neha and her mother bought bangles at the fair. The stall shone with red, gold, and blue. Neha slipped four shiny bangles onto her small wrist.
payload.title: Neha buys shiny bangles
decoys: The stall was at a fair

payload.passage: Rain poured during the long bus ride. Ravina rested her head on the window. She watched the raindrops join into little streams that raced across the cool glass.
payload.title: Watching rain streams on the bus

payload.passage: Riya went to buy a new umbrella. The shop had blue, green, and spotty ones. She picked a yellow umbrella with a duck handle and opened it once.
payload.title: Riya buys a new umbrella

payload.passage: We wear pretty bangles on our festival days. The shiny bangles are red and green in colour. They make a soft tinkling sound on our arms.
payload.title: We wear bangles for festivals

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, Saira draws a big sunflower on paper. She makes the round centre brown. She adds many bright yellow petals around it.
payload.title: Saira draws a sunflower

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, a friend cannot hold all his books. His friend takes a few. They walk to class side by side.
payload.title: Friends share the books to carry

payload.passage: Kangaroos are animals that can jump very far. They live in a faraway land across the sea. The tiny baby stays safe inside the mother's warm pouch.
payload.title: Kangaroos jump very far

payload.passage: Lizards are little animals with a long thin tail. They run very fast up the wall and across the floor. They catch small insects with their quick tongue to eat.
payload.title: Lizards catch small insects

payload.passage: Summer days are very long and very hot. The bright sun stays up high in the sky for many hours. We love to rest in the shade and drink cool water.
payload.title: Summer days are hot

payload.passage: Hriday helped Appa buy a new tap for the kitchen. The hardware shop was busy. They chose a shiny silver tap that the man wrapped neatly in newspaper.
payload.title: They buy a kitchen tap

payload.passage: During the school hours, Gopal learns to tie his shoe lace. His teacher shows him how to loop it. After a few tries, he does it himself.
payload.title: Gopal ties his shoe lace

payload.passage: On a busy school day, the children make cards for Teachers Day. They draw flowers and write nice words. The teacher loves all the cards.
payload.title: Cards for Teachers Day

payload.passage: Krish went shopping for a new lunchbox. The shelf had boxes shaped like animals. He chose a round box shaped like a panda with two little ears.
payload.title: Krish buys a panda lunchbox

payload.passage: On the Holi festival our pet dog hides away. The bright colours and loud noise scare the dog. It only comes back out when we all stop.
payload.title: The dog hides away on Holi

payload.passage: A festival makes all of us feel very glad. We sing happy songs and dance about. We forget all our sad and worried thoughts.
payload.title: A festival makes us all glad

payload.passage: The warm afternoon sun shone on the swings. Varun pushed his little sister higher. She laughed each time her feet rose up to touch the bright blue sky.
payload.title: A sunny day at the swings

payload.passage: Mahi helped Amma pick a gift for the new baby next door. They chose a soft yellow blanket. The shopkeeper wrapped it in pretty paper with a bow.
payload.title: They buy a gift for the baby

payload.passage: Carrots are long orange vegetables that we eat. They grow down under the soft soil in the garden. Rabbits and people both love to eat crunchy carrots.
payload.title: Carrots grow under the soil

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Yash sweeps the leaves in the school yard. He uses a long broom. He makes a small pile near the tree.
payload.title: Yash sweeps the school yard

payload.passage: Kabir helped Amma make the grocery list. She told him each item to write. He wrote oil, soap, and biscuits in his big, careful handwriting.
payload.title: Kabir writes the grocery list

payload.passage: Dhruvi went to the market to buy chalk and a duster. The shop sold pens too. She picked white chalk and a soft duster for her little blackboard at home.
payload.title: Dhruvi buys chalk and a duster

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, Suman brings a box of dates and nuts. She mixes them in a bowl. She shares the mix with friends.
payload.title: Suman shares dates and nuts

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, Riya learns to count with her fingers. She holds up five on one hand. Then she counts up to ten.
payload.title: Riya counts on her fingers

payload.passage: A waterfall is where a river falls down a high rock. The water comes rushing down very fast over the edge. It makes a loud splashing sound at the bottom.
payload.title: A waterfall falls from a rock

payload.passage: On the green play field, Ravi sees a friend with no toy. He gives his own car to him. He says, You play with it now.
payload.title: Ravi gives away his toy

payload.passage: Some lizards can drop off their own long tail. They do this clever trick to escape from danger. A brand new tail slowly grows back later.
payload.title: Some lizards drop their tail

payload.passage: A new boy named Sam joined the class. Karthik smiled and showed him the empty seat. By lunchtime, the two boys were sharing snacks and laughing like old friends.
payload.title: Karthik makes a new friend

payload.passage: After the first bell, it is the school photo day today. The children wear clean clothes. They stand in a line and smile.
payload.title: It is school photo day

payload.passage: Ravina and Amma bought a basket of plums. The fruit was soft and purple. The seller let Ravina pick the ones she liked and dropped them in gently.
payload.title: They buy purple plums

payload.passage: We happily help our mother on the festival days. We clean the whole house from top to bottom. We also help her set out all the food.
payload.title: We help mother at festivals

payload.passage: On the Diwali festival we say sorry to people. We make peace with everyone we know. We happily start the new year fresh and clean.
payload.title: We make peace on Diwali

payload.passage: A volcano is a big hill that can wake up. Hot orange fire and grey smoke come out of the top. It can also make a very loud rumbling sound.
payload.title: A volcano sends out fire

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, two friends share one big mat. They sit side by side. They eat their lunch together on the green field.
payload.title: Friends share a lunch mat

payload.passage: A girl named Disha moved into the flat below. Varun left a drawing at her door to say welcome. The next day she came up, smiling, to thank him.
payload.title: Varun welcomes a new neighbour

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Komal brings a big bunch of bananas. She gives one to each friend. They peel and eat them at break.
payload.title: Komal shares her bananas

payload.passage: In the bright morning, Nira draws her school building. She makes a big gate. She adds a flag on top while the teacher watches.
payload.title: Nira draws her school

payload.passage: Ira visited a big new garden with her family. It had fountains and rows of roses. She loved the splashing water and watched the spray sparkle in the sun.
payload.title: Ira visits the new garden

payload.passage: After the first bell, Ayaan keeps his school tie straight. He pulls it up to his neck. He checks it in a small mirror.
payload.title: Ayaan straightens his tie

payload.passage: Ahana helped Amma buy a new tablecloth. The rolls came in many prints. They chose a yellow one with red cherries for the small dining table.
payload.title: They buy a cherry tablecloth

payload.passage: An ostrich is a very big bird with long legs. It has wings but it cannot fly up in the sky. Instead it uses its strong legs to run very fast.
payload.title: An ostrich cannot fly
decoys: An ostrich is a big bird

payload.passage: On the Eid festival the children all get money. They feel very happy and excited about it. They run off to buy little toys with it.
payload.title: On Eid children get money

payload.passage: A cactus is a plant that grows in the dry desert. It can store a lot of water inside its thick stem. It is covered all over with sharp little spines.
payload.title: A cactus grows in the desert

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, two friends share one big drum. One taps, then the other taps. They make a steady beat without any fuss.
payload.title: Friends share a drum

payload.passage: A festival always brings us lots of good food. We get to eat much more than we usually do. By the end our tummies feel nice and full.
payload.title: A festival brings good food

payload.passage: Most cats can see very well in the dark night. Their special eyes catch even the tiniest bit of light. This good night sight helps them hunt for food.
payload.title: Cats see well at night

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, the class learns to clap a beat. The teacher claps slow then fast. The children copy her beat.
payload.title: Clapping a beat in class

payload.passage: When the day begins, the teacher shows ice melting in a bowl. The children watch it turn to water. They learn ice melts when warm.
payload.title: Watching ice melt in class
decoys: The ice is in a bowl

payload.passage: In the bright morning, Bina helps the teacher carry the books. The pile is tall and a bit heavy. She puts them on the big desk.
payload.title: Bina helps carry the books

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, a friend cannot blow a balloon. His friend blows it for him. He ties it with a knot.
payload.title: A friend blows a balloon

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, two girls share one packet of seeds. They plant them in one pot. They water the pot in turns.
payload.title: Friends share and plant seeds

payload.passage: At a birthday party we get to eat yummy cake. The cake is soft and sweet and tastes lovely. Each of us takes a nice big slice to eat.
payload.title: We eat cake at a party

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, today the teacher tells a story about a lion. The lion was strong but kind. The children love the tale.
payload.title: A story about a kind lion

payload.passage: Honey is a sweet food that is golden in colour. Busy bees make it inside their buzzing hive. We love to spread it on warm bread and eat it.
payload.title: Honey is sweet and golden
decoys: Honey is made in a hive

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the school bell rings for the break. The children rush out with their snacks. They sit under a shady tree.
payload.title: The break time at school

payload.passage: On the Holi festival we feel happy and free. We forget about all the everyday rules. We just laugh and play in the bright colours.
payload.title: On Holi we feel free

payload.passage: We thank the rain very much at the harvest time. The rain falls and fills up all our fields. It helps the crops to grow big and tall.
payload.title: We thank the rain at harvest

payload.passage: Krish visited a new park with a duck pond and a tall tower. He climbed the tower steps. From the top he could see the whole green park spread out below.
payload.title: Krish climbs the park tower
decoys: The park had a duck pond

payload.passage: Light rain fell as Neha walked to the bus stop. She held a bright pink umbrella. The drops made happy plinks on top while she hummed a little tune.
payload.title: Neha walks in light rain

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, a friend cannot reach his bag hook. His friend lifts the bag up. He hangs it on the hook.
payload.title: A friend hangs up the bag

payload.passage: Om helped his sister make her bed. He pulled the sheet flat while she tucked the sides. Together they plumped the pillows and laid the soft toy on top.
payload.title: They make the bed together
decoys: A soft toy went on top

payload.passage: Jellyfish are soft animals that float in the sea. Their round body feels soft and wobbly like jelly. They have long thin arms that hang down in the water.
payload.title: Jellyfish float in the sea

payload.passage: A banana is a long curved fruit that we eat. It has a soft yellow skin that we peel off first. Both monkeys and children love to eat sweet bananas.
payload.title: A banana is a long fruit

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the class learns a new game today. The teacher draws boxes on the floor. The children hop from box to box.
payload.title: Learning a hopping game

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, the class makes a paper clock. They cut a round shape. They add two hands with a pin.
payload.title: Making a paper clock

payload.passage: Saira helped sweep under the dining table. Crumbs from lunch lay all around. She brushed them into one tidy heap and swept them straight into the dustpan.
payload.title: Saira sweeps under the table

payload.passage: We thank god on our festival days. We all pray together quietly with our family. After praying we feel very calm and peaceful inside.
payload.title: We thank god at festivals

payload.passage: The sun shone brightly on the open ground. Shaurya joined a game of tag. He ran and dodged in the warm light until he was happily out of breath.
payload.title: Playing tag in the sun

payload.passage: Children always love the happy festival days. They get sweet treats and brand new clothes to wear. They run outside and play with all their friends.
payload.title: Children love festival days

payload.passage: Manoj met a friend at the new cycle track. They both had blue bicycles. They rode round and round, racing gently, and ended up laughing till their cheeks hurt.
payload.title: Manoj makes a cycling friend

payload.passage: Geeta bought new socks for the cold days. The shop had socks in stripes and dots. She chose three pairs, all soft and warm, in red and grey.
payload.title: Geeta buys warm socks

payload.passage: On the Diwali festival we visit the temple. We light a little lamp there and pray. We pray for the health of our whole family.
payload.title: On Diwali we visit the temple

payload.passage: On Diwali we feel like little children of light. The soft lamps glow gently all around us. We feel warm and very safe at home.
payload.title: Diwali fills us with light

payload.passage: When the day begins, Aditya keeps his pencils sharp. He uses a small sharpener. The shavings fall into a bin in the busy classroom.
payload.title: Aditya keeps his pencils sharp

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we paint the cooking pot. We tie a fresh green leaf around the top. We do all this to make the pot look pretty.
payload.title: On Pongal we paint the pot
decoys: We tie a leaf on top

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, a friend cannot open his bottle. His friend twists the cap for him. Now he can drink his water.
payload.title: A friend opens a tight bottle

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the class learns about a postman. The teacher shows a letter and a stamp. She says the postman brings post.
payload.title: Learning about a postman

payload.passage: We give away our old toys on festival days. We give them to poor children who have none. Giving the toys away makes them smile with joy.
payload.title: We give old toys to poor children

payload.passage: Naina went to the planetarium with her class. The room turned dark like night. Stars shone on the round roof, and she felt as if she were floating in space.
payload.title: Naina visits the planetarium

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, Sita brings a shiny new schoolbag. It is red with a star on it. She keeps her books neatly inside it.
payload.title: Sita's new red schoolbag

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Myra draws a big fish on paper. She gives it round eyes and fins. She colours it bright orange.
payload.title: Myra draws a fish

payload.passage: Grass is soft and green and grows on the ground. It spreads out over the open fields and parks. Cows and goats love to eat the fresh green grass.
payload.title: Grass is green and soft

payload.passage: The bright sun made the swimming day perfect. Chitra floated on her back in the pool. She looked up at the blue sky and felt the warm water hold her.
payload.title: A sunny day in the pool

payload.passage: It rained so much that a frog hopped onto the step. Vinay watched it with wide eyes. The frog blinked, gave one big hop, and vanished into the bushes.
payload.title: A frog visits in the rain
decoys: The frog sat on the step

payload.passage: During the lunch break, two girls share one swing seat. They sit side by side. They swing slowly and laugh in a kind way.
payload.title: Friends share a swing seat

payload.passage: On Diwali we paint pretty designs on our hands. We use a special paste to make the design. The lovely design dries to a dark red colour.
payload.title: We paint our hands on Diwali

payload.passage: Festivals come only once or twice every year. We happily wait for them to come with great joy. When they arrive they make us all very happy.
payload.title: Festivals come once a year

payload.passage: We love to watch a parade on festival days. People march along the road in bright clothes. There is happy music and joy all around.
payload.title: We watch a parade on festival days

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Pooja keeps her desk very tidy. Her books are in a neat row. Her pencil box sits in one corner.
payload.title: Pooja keeps her desk tidy
decoys: Her books are in a row

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, Aarav keeps the class bin clean. He empties it when it is full. He carries it to the big bin outside.
payload.title: Aarav keeps the bin clean

payload.passage: Bhavna visited a big new market in the city. The stalls sold toys, fruit, and balloons. She held a red balloon and stayed close to her mother in the crowd.
payload.title: Bhavna visits the new city market

payload.passage: Rohit helped Amma buy curd and butter. The dairy shop felt cool inside. The man packed everything in a paper bag and wished them a good day.
payload.title: They buy curd and butter

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, Kavya brings a tasty cake for her birthday. The class sings a happy song. She shares the cake with everyone.
payload.title: Kavya's birthday at school

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, the teacher tells the children to wash hands. They go to the tap one by one. They use soap and clean water.
payload.title: Washing hands at school

payload.passage: The hot afternoon sun made everyone sleepy. Nivaan found a cool spot under the stairs. He sipped cold buttermilk and fanned himself with a folded sheet of paper.
payload.title: Keeping cool on a hot day

payload.passage: Asha went to a brand new mall with her parents. It had bright lights and a fountain. She rode the glass lift up and down twice, watching the floors shrink below.
payload.title: Asha explores the new mall

payload.passage: On the Holi festival the streets are very full. So many people come out of their homes to play. The whole town is loud and full of colour.
payload.title: The streets are full on Holi

payload.passage: Ice slowly melts when the warm sun shines on it. It turns back from hard ice into runny water. If it gets cold again the water can freeze once more.
payload.title: Ice melts in the sun

payload.passage: Parth visited a busy harbour with his father. Big boats bobbed on the water. He watched fishermen pull in their nets, full of silver, wriggling fish.
payload.title: Parth visits the busy harbour

payload.passage: Sparrows are small birds that are brown in colour. They hop happily near our homes and gardens. They eat tiny seeds and little crumbs off the ground.
payload.title: Sparrows are small birds

payload.passage: On the Diwali festival we burst small crackers. Some little ones spin round and round on the ground. They throw out many tiny bright sparks.
payload.title: We burst small crackers on Diwali

payload.passage: We light many little lamps all over at night. Soon the whole house begins to glow with light. It looks just like a pretty fairy land.
payload.title: Lamps make the house glow

payload.passage: After the first bell, today the class learns about animals. The teacher shows pictures of a cow and a goat. Everyone learns the sounds they make.
payload.title: The class learns about animals
decoys: There is a picture of a goat

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, Nikhil has a big slice of melon. He gives half to his friend. They both enjoy the sweet fruit.
payload.title: Nikhil shares his melon

payload.passage: A girl named Riddhi was new at the dance class. Mishka took her hand kindly. She showed her two simple steps, and soon both girls were twirling and laughing.
payload.title: Mishka helps Riddhi dance

payload.passage: Ved and his mother bought a bunch of grapes. The grapes were small and green. The seller washed them in cool water before he packed them in a bag.
payload.title: They buy green grapes

payload.passage: We sing happy songs together at our festivals. The whole family joins in and sings as one. It makes us all feel warm and very happy.
payload.title: We sing songs at festivals

payload.passage: Ishaan met a new friend at the kite ground. They both struggled to fly their kites. They helped hold each other's string, and soon both kites soared high.
payload.title: Ishaan makes a kite-flying friend

payload.passage: Ants leave a tiny smell trail on the ground as they walk. Other ants from the nest follow this little trail. The trail leads all of them straight to the food.
payload.title: Ants follow a scent trail

payload.passage: On Holi we love to sing and dance. We beat happily on a loud drum together. We jump and move all around in the colours.
payload.title: We sing and dance on Holi

payload.passage: Roopa helped grandmother roll the wool into balls. The wool had got all tangled. Roopa wound it round and round until three neat balls sat in the basket.
payload.title: Roopa rolls the wool

payload.passage: We light bright crackers on the Diwali night. They shoot up high with a flash of light. Then they burst and make a very loud sound.
payload.title: We light crackers on Diwali
decoys: They go up with a flash

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, the teacher writes the date on the board. She tells the day and the month. The children copy it in their books.
payload.title: Writing the date in class

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the teacher asks a question in class. Many hands go up in the air. Anita gives the right answer and smiles.
payload.title: Anita answers the teacher

payload.passage: Thunder is the loud booming sound that we hear. It comes along with the heavy rain in a storm. Bright lightning also flashes across the dark sky.
payload.title: Thunder is a loud sound

payload.passage: It rained while the family was at the fair. Everyone opened umbrellas at once. Lata stayed on the merry-go-round and felt the cool drops on her cheeks.
payload.title: Rain falls at the fair

payload.passage: Rain tapped softly on the umbrella. Yash and his mother walked to the temple. The wet road shone, and small lamps glowed warmly through the falling drops.
payload.title: A rainy walk to the temple

payload.passage: Vanya helped grandmother roll out the dough balls. She pressed each one flat. Grandmother cooked them on the pan while Vanya counted them into a warm stack.
payload.title: Vanya helps roll the dough

payload.passage: Joy went to the market on a sunny day. He wore his cap to shade his eyes. He bought peaches and grapes and ate one grape on the way home.
payload.title: Joy shops on a sunny day

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, a friend cannot reach his lunch shelf. His friend gets it down. He opens it and eats.
payload.title: A friend gets the lunch down

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, it is the last day before holidays. The children sing and play happily. They wish each other a fun break.
payload.title: The last day before holidays

payload.passage: Kriti and her father bought a basket of strawberries. The fruit was small and bright red. The seller said to eat them quickly before they turned too soft.
payload.title: They buy red strawberries
decoys: They had to eat them fast

payload.passage: Chitra and her aunt bought new bedsheets. The pile was soft and folded neatly. They picked a green sheet with yellow stars for Chitra's little bed.
payload.title: They buy a new bedsheet

payload.passage: We give a small gift to each of our guests. We wrap up each little gift very nicely. They smile with joy when they open them.
payload.title: We give a small gift to each guest

payload.passage: The morning was bright and clear. Dev rode his bicycle around the colony. The warm sun touched his face, and the cool breeze made the ride feel lovely.
payload.title: Dev rides his bike in the sun

payload.passage: Sneha helped Amma choose new curtains. The shop had cloth in many soft colours. They picked light blue curtains with little white clouds printed on them.
payload.title: They choose new curtains

payload.passage: The summer sun was very strong. Roopa and her cousins set up a small water slide in the yard. They slid down again and again until they were soaked.
payload.title: A water slide on a hot day
decoys: They set it in the yard

payload.passage: We send pretty cards to people on special days. We carefully write kind and loving words inside them. The lovely cards make everyone smile with joy.
payload.title: We give cards on special days

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Asha looks at the wall clock in class. The short hand points to twelve. She knows it is time for lunch.
payload.title: Asha reads the class clock

payload.passage: On a busy school day, it is craft day in the classroom. The children stick coloured paper on a chart. They make a big paper kite.
payload.title: Craft day in the classroom
decoys: They stick it on a chart

payload.passage: A new boy named Hari joined the chess club. Aditya offered to teach him a move. They played a slow, friendly game and shook hands warmly at the end.
payload.title: Aditya teaches Hari chess

payload.passage: A spider's web can catch tiny drops of water. After the rain the whole web shines in the light. The drops on the thread look just like little beads.
payload.title: A spider's web catches rain drops

payload.passage: Rain pattered on the school windows all morning. Farhan could not go out for games. So the class sang songs and played quiet games inside instead.
payload.title: A rainy day inside the class

payload.passage: On Diwali we eat our dinner quite late at night. The whole family sits down together to eat. We happily share many tasty dishes between us.
payload.title: We eat a big dinner on Diwali

payload.passage: During the school hours, Avni keeps her books in order. She puts the maths book first. Then she puts the reading book.
payload.title: Avni orders her books

payload.passage: We hold hands and dance together at festivals. We move round and round in a big happy ring. We laugh and twirl along with all our friends.
payload.title: We hold hands and dance at festivals

payload.passage: Out in the playground, two friends build a sand tower. One brings water, one shapes the sand. They make it tall together.
payload.title: Friends build a sand tower

payload.passage: The sunny day was hot, so Rahul made a cool lemon drink. He squeezed the lemons and added sugar and ice. Then he shared a tall, frosty glass with each friend.
payload.title: A cool drink on a hot day

payload.passage: While they play together, Seema has a packet of nuts. She opens it at break. She shares a handful with her friends.
payload.title: Seema shares her nuts

payload.passage: Sheep are farm animals covered in soft white wool. The kind farmer carefully cuts the thick wool off them. We use the wool to make warm clothes for winter.
payload.title: Sheep give us wool

payload.passage: Owls can turn their head a very long way around. They can even look right behind their own back. This helps them watch for food on every side.
payload.title: Owls can turn their head far

payload.passage: Crows are clever birds that are black all over. They say caw caw loudly all through the day. They are smart and find their food very fast.
payload.title: Crows are clever black birds

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we use a brand new pot. We boil the fresh milk in the new pot. We let it spill over for good luck.
payload.title: We use a new pot on Pongal

payload.passage: Rahul met a new friend on the school trip bus. They sat together at the back. They shared a window seat and pointed at every cow and pond they passed.
payload.title: Rahul makes a friend on the trip

payload.passage: We all sing for the birthday child at the party. Everyone says a loud and happy birthday together. Then we all clap our hands with great joy.
payload.title: We sing for the birthday child

payload.passage: A baby bird slowly grows its feathers as it gets big. At first its body is covered in soft little fluff. Then strong feathers come in so it can fly.
payload.title: A baby bird grows feathers

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, two friends share one swing rope. They push each other in turns. They both go up very high.
payload.title: Friends push each other's swing

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, Anaya reads a chart of farm animals. She points to a cow and a pig. She says each animal's name aloud.
payload.title: Anaya reads the animal chart

payload.passage: We greet all our elders on the festival days. We bend down and touch the feet of the elders. They smile and bless us with all their love.
payload.title: We greet elders on festivals

payload.passage: After the first bell, the teacher reads a poem aloud. It is about the rain and clouds. The children listen very quietly.
payload.title: The teacher reads a poem

payload.passage: A girl named Dhruvi was new at the painting class. Myra shared her paint pots. Together they mixed colours and painted a bright rainbow on one big sheet.
payload.title: Myra shares paints with Dhruvi

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Jatin brings a packet of chips. He opens it for his friends. He makes sure everyone gets some.
payload.title: Jatin shares his chips

payload.passage: A nest full of eggs stays nice and warm. The mother bird sits gently on top of them every day. Soon the eggs crack open and little chicks come out.
payload.title: Eggs hatch into chicks

payload.passage: On the green play field, two friends share one big chart. One draws on the left side. One draws on the right side.
payload.title: Friends share a chart

payload.passage: On Diwali we go to visit all our cousins. We play many fun games together with them. We laugh and have a wonderful time all day.
payload.title: We visit cousins on Diwali

payload.passage: Cats are soft and very clean animals. They lick their own fur many times a day to stay neat and tidy. They also love to sleep a lot in the warm sun.
payload.title: Cats are clean animals

payload.passage: While they play together, a friend drops his water bottle. The cap rolls under a desk. His friend crawls and brings it back.
payload.title: A friend finds the lost cap

payload.passage: Early in the day, Ananya keeps a small plant on her desk. She gives it a little water. She talks to it every day.
payload.title: Ananya cares for her plant

payload.passage: During the lunch break, a friend cannot reach a top shelf. His friend brings a stool. He climbs up and gets the box.
payload.title: A friend brings a stool to help

payload.passage: We light the lamps slowly one after the other. We light the first one and then all the rest. Soon the whole room fills up with warm light.
payload.title: We light lamps one by one

payload.passage: Aryan helped water the front garden every evening. He filled the can at the tap. He gave the roses and the small lemon tree a long, gentle drink.
payload.title: Aryan waters the front garden

payload.passage: Aditi went to a new fruit farm with her class. They walked between the orange trees. The farmer let each child pluck one ripe orange to take home.
payload.title: Aditi visits the fruit farm

payload.passage: Shaurya helped fold the dry bedsheets. He held one corner up high. He and Amma folded slowly together and stacked them neatly on the shelf.
payload.title: Shaurya folds the bedsheets

payload.passage: Bhavna helped grandmother grind the spices. She held the lid while it spun. The kitchen filled with a warm smell, and the spices turned into fine powder.
payload.title: Bhavna helps grind the spices

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Mohit brings sweets on his birthday. He gives one to each friend. He keeps a few for the teachers.
payload.title: Mohit shares birthday sweets

payload.passage: Kavya watered all the plants on the balcony. She gave each pot just enough. The dry leaves perked up, and a few buds began to open in the sunshine.
payload.title: Kavya waters the plants

payload.passage: On Eid we cook a big and tasty feast. We make many sweet and warm dishes to share. We sit and eat the feast with all our family.
payload.title: On Eid we cook a big feast

payload.passage: When the day begins, Ishaan helps a small child find the class. The little one was lost in the hall. Ishaan walks her to the right door.
payload.title: Ishaan helps a lost child

payload.passage: On the Holi festival the whole town joins in. People come out and play on every street. The streets are full of colour and joy.
payload.title: The whole town joins on Holi

payload.passage: A new boy named Yuvan joined the swimming class. Hriday waved hello from the pool. They held the float together, and Yuvan soon felt brave in the water.
payload.title: Hriday welcomes Yuvan to swimming

payload.passage: Saira and Amma bought a soft new towel. The pile was warm and thick. They chose a blue one with a duck so Saira could dry off after her bath.
payload.title: They buy a soft bath towel

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, Govind has a big bunch of grapes. He shares them with two friends. They eat the sweet grapes in the shade.
payload.title: Govind shares his grapes

payload.passage: On our birthday we get many lovely gifts. We open each one with great joy and excitement. Then we say a big thank you to everyone.
payload.title: We get gifts on a birthday

payload.passage: The warm sun melted the morning chill. Asha and her father went boating on the lake. They rowed slowly and watched ducks paddle past their little boat.
payload.title: A sunny boat ride on the lake

payload.passage: Trees are very good and useful for us. They give us cool shade to sit under on hot summer days. They also clean the air and give us fresh air to breathe.
payload.title: Trees are good for us

payload.passage: Sunflowers are big yellow flowers that love the sun. They slowly turn to follow the sun across the sky. They are tall and bright and stand up high in the field.
payload.title: Sunflowers turn to the sun

payload.passage: When the day begins, the class learns to count by twos. The teacher claps two times. The children clap and count along.
payload.title: Counting by twos in class

payload.passage: Turtles are slow animals that move along the ground. They have a hard round shell on their back to keep them safe. They hide inside the shell when they feel scared.
payload.title: Turtles have a hard shell
decoys: The shell is on the back

payload.passage: Rain fell softly as Rishi walked under the trees. Drops slid off the leaves above. He opened his mouth and tried to catch one tiny drop on his tongue.
payload.title: Rishi catches falling raindrops outside

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the teacher hands out new notebooks. Each one has a blue cover. The children write their names on them.
payload.title: New notebooks for the class

payload.passage: During the school hours, the class makes a chart of fruits. They draw an apple, a banana, and a grape. The chart looks very colourful.
payload.title: The class makes a fruit chart

payload.passage: Geese are big birds that fly off to warmer lands. They fly together high up in one long line. They honk loudly to each other as they go along.
payload.title: Geese fly to warmer lands

payload.passage: Veer visited a tall lighthouse by the sea. He climbed the long, winding stairs. At the top he saw the big blue ocean stretch far past the boats below.
payload.title: Veer climbs the lighthouse

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, Karan brings his story book to school. He shows the bright pictures to his friends. They all look at the pages together.
payload.title: Karan shares his story book

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, two girls share one packet of straws. They use them for a craft. They make a long paper chain.
payload.title: Friends share straws for craft

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls share one skipping rope. One turns it, one jumps. Then they swap and play again in a kind way.
payload.title: Friends share a skipping rope

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, the school has a big sports field. Children play cricket near the trees. The ground is full of soft green grass.
payload.title: The big school sports field

payload.passage: While they play together, a friend's shoe lace comes off. His friend ties it back. He pulls it tight and neat near the school gate.
payload.title: A friend ties a loose lace

payload.passage: The sun gives us bright light and warm heat. It slowly rises up in the morning and goes down at night. Plants and trees need the sun so they can grow well.
payload.title: The sun gives light and heat

payload.passage: We all dress up nicely for a festival. We put on our very best and finest clothes. When we look in the mirror we look very smart.
payload.title: We dress up for festivals

payload.passage: It was a hot, sunny afternoon. Arjun and Sam sat under a striped umbrella at the beach. They sipped cool juice and dug a deep hole in the wet sand.
payload.title: A sunny day at the beach

payload.passage: Reena helped grandmother sweep the temple corner at home. She dusted the small shelf. Then she placed fresh flowers and lit a tiny lamp for the evening.
payload.title: Reena tidies the prayer corner

payload.passage: A festival brings lots of happy noise all around. We hear loud drums and ringing bells everywhere. We also hear children laughing and playing.
payload.title: A festival brings happy noise

payload.passage: On the green play field, Manu sees his friend feel sad. He gives him a kind hug. Soon his friend feels much better.
payload.title: Manu cheers up his friend

payload.passage: Nivaan helped Amma make the salad bowl. He washed the cucumbers and carrots. Then he chopped them into little pieces and squeezed a fresh lemon on top.
payload.title: Nivaan helps make the salad

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls find a lost puppy. They give it some milk. They keep it warm till it is found.
payload.title: Friends help a lost puppy

payload.passage: Shaurya visited a big observatory at night. A guide showed him a huge telescope. He peeked through it and saw the round white moon look surprisingly close.
payload.title: Shaurya visits the observatory

payload.passage: A birthday comes around only once each year. On this day we turn one whole year older. It makes us feel big and very grown up.
payload.title: A birthday comes once a year

payload.passage: When the day begins, the children learn about the night sky. The teacher shows stars and a moon. They learn the sky turns dark at night.
payload.title: Learning about the night sky

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival the cows look very pretty. We paint their long horns in bright colours. We also tie pretty flowers around their necks.
payload.title: On Pongal cows look pretty

payload.passage: At the busy school, a friend feels sick in class. His friend tells the teacher. He helps him to the sick room.
payload.title: A friend helps a sick boy

payload.passage: A girl named Esha moved into the upstairs flat. Yuvan left her a welcome card. The next morning she came down, smiling, with a small box of sweets to share.
payload.title: Yuvan welcomes the upstairs girl

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, Ahaan draws a big bus in art. He gives it many windows. He puts children inside it in a happy way.
payload.title: Ahaan draws a bus

payload.passage: Rain splashed off the umbrella as Mishka walked home. She wore her favourite boots. She stamped through each puddle and made the water jump high around her feet.
payload.title: Mishka stamps through puddles

payload.passage: Shruti helped sort the buttons in grandmother's tin. She made little groups by colour. The red ones, blue ones, and shiny gold ones each got their own pile.
payload.title: Shruti sorts the buttons

payload.passage: Kiran bought a torch for the dark nights. He tried a few in the shop. He chose a small silver one that gave a strong yellow light.
payload.title: Kiran buys a bright torch

payload.passage: We hang a big bright star at the window. It glows and shines very brightly at night. People walking by stop just to look at it.
payload.title: We hang a bright star at the window

payload.passage: Most kinds of snakes lay eggs to have their babies. The eggs have a soft bendy shell, not a hard one. After some time the baby snakes hatch out of them.
payload.title: Most snakes lay eggs

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, two friends each have a few stickers. They swap to make a full set. Now both their books look full.
payload.title: Friends swap their stickers

payload.passage: Early in the day, Rohit forgets his lunch box at home. He feels very hungry at noon. His teacher gives him a banana to eat.
payload.title: The teacher helps hungry Rohit

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, the bus comes to take the children home. They wave bye to their teacher. They climb in and find their seats.
payload.title: Children go home from school

payload.passage: At the busy school, Aaravi has a basket of plums and figs. She lays them on a mat. She shares them with her group.
payload.title: Aaravi shares plums and figs

payload.passage: Reyansh helped Appa fix the squeaky door. They put a drop of oil on the hinge. Reyansh swung the door open and shut, and the squeak was gone.
payload.title: They fix the squeaky door

payload.passage: After the first bell, Kabir keeps his desk free of mess. He puts pens in the box. He stacks his books in a pile.
payload.title: Kabir tidies his desk

payload.passage: Our grandparents love to tell us nice stories. They tell these special stories on the festival days. The stories teach us many good and kind things.
payload.title: Grandparents tell festival stories

payload.passage: Mud is soft soil that has become wet and sticky. Pigs and ducks love to play around in it. But we must always wash the mud off our hands.
payload.title: Mud is wet soft soil

payload.passage: Big drops of rain fell on the market roof. Aditya and Amma waited inside a shop. They watched the busy street turn shiny and full of bobbing umbrellas.
payload.title: Waiting out the rain in a shop

payload.passage: Tara visited a sweet shop with her father. Trays of colourful sweets sat behind the glass. She pointed at a yellow one, and the man packed a box.
payload.title: Tara visits a sweet shop
decoys: Tara pointed at a yellow sweet

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Pinky drops her pencils on the floor. Her friend bends down to help. Together they pick up every pencil.
payload.title: A friend helps pick up pencils

payload.passage: Thunder rumbled as the rain came down hard. Aryan and Amma stayed cosy indoors. They made paper boats and raced them in the water near the gate after.
payload.title: Paper boats after the storm

payload.passage: Tiny seeds can grow into big healthy plants. We push a small seed gently down into the soft soil. With enough water and sunlight it slowly starts to grow.
payload.title: Seeds grow into plants

payload.passage: Bears are big animals with thick brown fur. They love to find and eat sweet sticky honey. They sleep in a warm cave all through the cold winter.
payload.title: Bears are big furry animals

payload.passage: When the day begins, Reyansh draws a tall tree in art. He adds green leaves on top. He puts a bird on a branch.
payload.title: Reyansh draws a tree

payload.passage: Krishiv went to the market to buy a coconut. The seller had a big pile. He chopped the top off one, and Krishiv drank the sweet water with a straw.
payload.title: Krishiv buys a coconut to drink

payload.passage: Many birds fly far to the south for the winter. They go to warm places where there is plenty of food. When the spring comes again they fly back home.
payload.title: Birds fly south in winter
decoys: They go where it is warm

payload.passage: Farhan went to a new park with a giant slide. He felt nervous climbing up. But a friendly kid went first, so Farhan slid down too and shrieked with joy.
payload.title: Farhan tries the giant slide

payload.passage: Karthik went to buy a present for his teacher. He looked at pens, cards, and plants. He chose a small green plant in a clay pot for her desk.
payload.title: Karthik buys a gift plant

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we wear new clothes. We go out and visit all of our friends. We share the happy festival food with them.
payload.title: On Pongal we wear new clothes

payload.passage: We all pray together at our festivals. We close our eyes and fold our hands quietly. After praying we feel very calm and happy inside.
payload.title: We pray together at festivals

payload.passage: The family walked through the busy market. Sellers called out their prices loudly. People carried full bags, and a sweet smell came from a snack cart.
payload.title: The busy market is full of people

payload.passage: Leela bought a soft toy rabbit from the toy stall. Its ears were long and floppy. She hugged it close and named it Snowy on the way home.
payload.title: Leela buys a toy rabbit

payload.passage: It poured down while the children were at school. Riya had forgotten her umbrella. Her friend shared one, and they walked home close together, laughing all the way.
payload.title: Riya's friend shares an umbrella

payload.passage: During their free time, a friend cannot find her seat. Her friend stands and waves. She comes and sits beside her in a kind way.
payload.title: A friend saves her a seat

payload.passage: Every festival has plenty of tasty food. Mothers work hard to cook special dishes for it. Soon the whole house smells warm and very nice.
payload.title: Festivals have tasty food

payload.passage: Saanvi went to a big science centre. She pressed buttons that made lights flash. One machine showed her shadow turning into many bright colours on the wall.
payload.title: Saanvi visits the science centre

payload.passage: After the first bell, the children draw their own family. Each one draws mother and father. They add their pets and friends too.
payload.title: Drawing my family in class

payload.passage: Devraj went to a new cricket academy. He felt nervous holding the bat. But a friendly coach showed him how to stand, and his first shot flew far.
payload.title: Devraj joins a cricket academy

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Arjun forgot his pencil at home. His friend Sam gave him an extra one. Arjun said thank you and started his work.
payload.title: A friend lends Arjun a pencil

payload.passage: Crocodiles are big animals that live in the river. They have many long and very sharp teeth in their mouth. They float along quietly in the water to hide.
payload.title: Crocodiles live in the river

payload.passage: Bees, ants and flies are all kinds of insects. Every one of them has six legs on its body. Their little body is also split into three parts.
payload.title: Insects have six legs

payload.passage: During the school hours, the teacher gives gold stars for good work. Tina gets one star on her page. She runs home to show her mother.
payload.title: Tina earns a gold star

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the school bell rings loudly in the morning. All the children stop their games. They line up and walk slowly to their classrooms.
payload.title: The school bell starts the day

payload.passage: Om went to buy a new mug for his milk. The shelf was full of cups and mugs. He chose a green one with a smiling frog on the side.
payload.title: Om buys a frog mug

payload.passage: Parth helped Appa fix the wobbly table. They tightened each loose leg. Parth held the table still, and soon it stood firm without any shaking at all.
payload.title: They fix the wobbly table

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, two friends each bring half a game. One has the board, one has the dice. They play it together at break.
payload.title: Friends share a board game

payload.passage: A new boy named Vikram joined the music class. Sneha showed him the small drums. They tapped out a beat together, and the whole class clapped along happily.
payload.title: Sneha welcomes Vikram to music

payload.passage: The day a new baby comes is a very happy one. The whole family comes together to meet the baby. They all bring lovely little gifts for the baby.
payload.title: A new baby is a happy day
decoys: The gifts are for the baby

payload.passage: The sun was bright, so the children played hopscotch in the lane. They drew boxes with chalk. Lakshmi hopped without touching a single line and grinned.
payload.title: Playing hopscotch in the sun
decoys: Lakshmi did not touch a line

payload.passage: Tanvi helped fold the heavy blankets. She held one end while Amma held the other. Together they made neat folds and stacked them on the high shelf.
payload.title: They fold the heavy blankets

payload.passage: After the first bell, the teacher shows how a plant drinks. She puts the stem in red water. By noon the flower turns a little red.
payload.title: Watching a plant drink

payload.passage: Shaurya went to the market to buy a ball of string. The shop had thick rolls. He needed it to fly his kite and tie a swing for his teddy.
payload.title: Shaurya buys a ball of string

payload.passage: Spiders make pretty webs out of thin silk thread. The web feels sticky and is much stronger than it looks. Small flying insects get stuck in the web.
payload.title: Spiders make sticky webs

payload.passage: On the green play field, a friend cannot reach the tall plant. His friend lifts the pot down. He waters it with care.
payload.title: A friend lowers the tall plant

payload.passage: During their free time, Mishti brings a tray of buns. She gives one to each friend. They eat them warm at break.
payload.title: Mishti shares her buns

payload.passage: A flower on a plant slowly turns into a fruit. The fruit holds many tiny seeds safe inside it. New baby plants can grow up from these little seeds.
payload.title: A flower turns into fruit

payload.passage: Avni helped Amma pack the school tiffin. She put rice in one box and fruit in another. Then she zipped the bag so nothing would tip and spill.
payload.title: Avni packs the school tiffin

payload.passage: Lions are big and strong wild cats. They have a deep loud roar that we can hear from far away. People call the lion the brave king of the jungle.
payload.title: Lions are strong wild cats

payload.passage: In the bright morning, today the children learn the days of the week. The teacher writes them on the board. Everyone says them out loud.
payload.title: Learning the days of the week

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we visit the green fields. We see the tall ripe crops growing there. The sight makes us feel happy and very proud.
payload.title: On Pongal we visit the fields
