payload.passage: Naveen helped polish the brass lamps. He rubbed each one with a soft cloth. The dull lamps turned bright and golden, ready for the evening prayers.
payload.title: Naveen polishes the lamps

payload.passage: Vanya went to a new bakery with her mother. The smell of warm bread filled the air. She watched the baker shape soft buns and sprinkle seeds on top.
payload.title: Vanya visits the warm bakery

payload.passage: Nikhil helped carry the heavy water buckets. He took small, careful steps so none would spill. He filled the big drum, and Amma thanked him with a warm hug.
payload.title: Nikhil fills the water drum

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the children visit the school kitchen. They see the big pots of rice. The cook gives them warm food to eat.
payload.title: A visit to the school kitchen

payload.passage: Tejas helped grandmother sort the lentils. They tipped them onto a wide plate. He picked out the tiny stones one by one so the food would be safe.
payload.title: Tejas picks stones from the lentils

payload.passage: Meena and her mother went to buy new shoes. The shop had many colours on the shelves. Meena tried three pairs and chose the shiny pink ones.
payload.title: Meena picks new shoes

payload.passage: A boy named Ayaan moved next to Tisha's house. She showed him the way to the shop. They walked the new path together and spotted a kitten under a parked car.
payload.title: Tisha shows Ayaan the way

payload.passage: Saanvi tidied her room before her friend came. She put toys in the box and books on the shelf. Then she made her bed and smoothed the bright cover.
payload.title: Saanvi tidies her room

payload.passage: Crabs are little animals that live on the sandy beach. They walk in a funny way, moving sideways on the sand. They have two strong claws to catch their food.
payload.title: Crabs live on the beach

payload.passage: On the green play field, two friends share one cricket bat. They take turns to bat and bowl. They cheer for each other too.
payload.title: Friends share a cricket bat

payload.passage: Worms are little animals that wiggle in the wet mud. They have a long soft body and no legs at all. Hungry birds love to dig them up and eat them.
payload.title: Worms wiggle in the mud

payload.passage: A shark is a big fish that lives in the sea. It has rows of many sharp pointed teeth in its mouth. It swims very fast through the deep water.
payload.title: A shark is a big fish

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, Neha learns to write her own name. She makes each letter big and clear. The teacher gives her a happy smile.
payload.title: Neha writes her name

payload.passage: Sita helped grandmother oil her long grey hair. She rubbed the warm oil in gently. Then she combed out the tangles until the hair was smooth and shiny.
payload.title: Sita oils grandmother's hair

payload.passage: Krish visited a hill town for the first time. The air was cool and the roads went up and down. He saw clouds floating below the road and felt very happy.
payload.title: Krish visits a hill town
decoys: The roads went up and down

payload.passage: A baby cow learns to eat grass as it grows up. At first it only drinks warm milk from its mother. Slowly it learns to chew the soft green grass too.
payload.title: A baby cow learns to eat grass

payload.passage: The sea is very big and looks bright blue. Its water is salty and not at all sweet like a drink. Big heavy ships sail across the top of the wide sea.
payload.title: The sea is big and blue

payload.passage: Parth went to a new water park with slides. He felt scared at the top of one. But a kind boy went first, so Parth slid down too with a happy yell.
payload.title: Parth tries the water slide

payload.passage: Myra and her aunt bought new ribbons for her hair. The stall had bright spools. Myra chose a long red ribbon and a thin gold one to match her dress.
payload.title: Myra buys hair ribbons
decoys: She got a gold one too

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, two friends share one bag of leaves. They sort them by their size. They paste them on a chart.
payload.title: Friends share and sort leaves

payload.passage: Vinay went to the market to buy a gift for his mother. He chose a small mirror with a wooden frame. He hid it in his bag as a surprise.
payload.title: Vinay buys a surprise gift
decoys: He hid it in his bag

payload.passage: Reyansh visited a new temple with his grandmother. The bells rang softly. He liked the cool stone floor and the rows of tiny lamps glowing along the wall.
payload.title: Reyansh visits the new temple

payload.passage: On Holi we hug our friends and make up. We say sorry for any old fights we had. Then we all start fresh and happy together.
payload.title: We make peace on Holi

payload.passage: A chick is the tiny baby of a hen or bird. It is small and soft and cannot fly at first. The kind mother bird brings it food to eat.
payload.title: A baby bird is a chick

payload.passage: Mohan went to buy a school bag. The shop had bags with cars, stars, and tigers. He chose a blue bag with a tiger and two side pockets.
payload.title: Mohan picks a tiger school bag

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we share sweet rice. We happily give the tasty rice to our friends. We sit down and eat it together with love.
payload.title: On Pongal we share sweet rice

payload.passage: In the bright morning, Raju writes the letters on his slate. He makes the letter A and B. The teacher says his work is very neat.
payload.title: Raju practises his letters

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we wake up very early. We cook the special food in the morning sun. Then we happily greet the bright new day.
payload.title: On Pongal we wake up early

payload.passage: Ishaan helped wash the car windows. He sprayed water on the dusty glass. He rubbed in small circles until the windows were clear enough to see right through.
payload.title: Ishaan washes the car windows

payload.passage: Wind is moving air that we can feel on our skin. We cannot see the wind with our eyes at all. But it is strong and can push the kites up high.
payload.title: Wind is moving air

payload.passage: On our birthday we get a special treat. We eat sweet cold ice cream after the cake. The whole day makes us feel very special and happy.
payload.title: We get treats on a birthday

payload.passage: Geeta helped feed the family hens. She scattered grain across the yard. The hens rushed over, pecking quickly, and one big brown hen ate the most of all.
payload.title: Geeta feeds the hens

payload.passage: A festival fills the whole air with happy sound. We hear ringing bells and beating drums all day. We also hear children laughing and playing.
payload.title: A festival fills the air with sound

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the children clean their classroom. They pick up the paper bits. They put the chairs in a neat row.
payload.title: Children clean their classroom

payload.passage: Toucans are birds with a huge bright beak. The big beak is painted in many lovely colours. But it is very light and not heavy at all.
payload.title: Toucans have a huge beak

payload.passage: The bright sun shone on sports day morning. Kriti tied on her running shoes. She lined up at the start, ready to race across the warm, green field.
payload.title: Getting ready to race in the sun

payload.passage: Anika went to a shop to buy a sun hat for the holiday. There were many to try. She chose a pink one with a wide brim that shaded her whole face.
payload.title: Anika buys a pink sun hat

payload.passage: Fog is a thick white mist that fills the air. It floats low and hides the road from us in the morning. It is hard to see very far ahead in the fog.
payload.title: Fog is a thick mist

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Veer keeps his shoes near the class door. He takes them off before going in. He puts them in a neat pair.
payload.title: Veer keeps his shoes neatly
decoys: He keeps them by the door

payload.passage: Ayaan helped water the rooftop plants in the evening. He climbed up with the can. He gave each green pot a drink and watched the leaves drip in the soft light.
payload.title: Ayaan waters the rooftop plants

payload.passage: A coral is a strange thing that lives in the warm sea. It looks just like a colourful plant but it is alive. Many small bright fish swim and live near it.
payload.title: A coral lives in the sea

payload.passage: Out in the playground, a friend feels cold in the room. His friend lends his jacket. He puts it on and feels warm.
payload.title: A friend lends his jacket

payload.passage: During the school hours, today the class learns the alphabet song. They sing from A to Z. The teacher points to each letter.
payload.title: Singing the alphabet song

payload.passage: Kiran visited a fire station with his class. A kind firefighter showed them the big red truck. Kiran got to hold the heavy helmet and sit in the driver's seat.
payload.title: Kiran visits the fire station

payload.passage: We feel very close to one another at festivals. The whole family meets up on these happy days. We hug each other and share our love.
payload.title: We feel close at festivals

payload.passage: A new girl joined the football game in the park. Chitra passed her the ball at once. The new girl scored a goal, and everyone clapped and cheered for her.
payload.title: A new girl joins the game

payload.passage: A new boy named Krishiv joined the football team. Reyan passed him the ball. Krishiv kicked it into the goal, and his happy new teammates lifted him up.
payload.title: Reyan welcomes Krishiv to football

payload.passage: Bamboo is a very tall plant that grows in clumps. It shoots up and grows faster than most other plants. Hungry pandas love to munch on the green bamboo.
payload.title: Bamboo grows very fast

payload.passage: Joy went to a new park across town. It had swings, a tall slide, and a sandpit. He made a friend at the sandpit, and they built a big castle.
payload.title: Joy makes a friend at the park
decoys: The park had a tall slide

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we share with our neighbours. We give them a bowl of sweet rice to eat. They thank us with warm and happy smiles.
payload.title: On Pongal we share with neighbours

payload.passage: On Holi we play with soft dry colours too. We gently rub the bright colour on each cheek. Then we all look very funny and laugh.
payload.title: We use dry colours on Holi

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, the teacher shows a real feather. It is soft and very light. The children blow it into the air.
payload.title: Playing with a feather

payload.passage: A new boy named Hriday joined the chess club. Ahana taught him how the horse moves. They played a friendly game and shook hands when it was done.
payload.title: Ahana teaches Hriday chess

payload.passage: Beavers are clever animals that build a wall in the river. They pile up sticks and mud to make it strong. The wall holds back the water and makes a small pond.
payload.title: Beavers build a wall in rivers

payload.passage: Riya and her cousin bought ice golas from a cart. The man shaved ice and poured red syrup. They licked the cold treat as they walked through the market.
payload.title: They buy cold ice golas

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, a friend feels too shy to sing. The others hold her hand. They sing along to help her.
payload.title: Friends help a shy singer

payload.passage: The day was hot and dry. Anu and her mother sat under a tree and ate slices of cold watermelon. The sweet, pink juice ran down Anu's chin.
payload.title: Cold watermelon on a hot day

payload.passage: Riddhi helped grandmother sort the lentils on a plate. She looked closely. She picked out the tiny stones one by one so the food would be safe to cook.
payload.title: Riddhi cleans the lentils

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the children make a noise board for class. They tap a drum and ring a bell. They learn loud and soft sounds.
payload.title: Making sounds in class

payload.passage: We share our sweets with the whole street at festivals. We knock on each door to give the sweets. Everyone smiles back at us with happy faces.
payload.title: We share sweets with the street

payload.passage: Mohan helped fill the rice jar from the big sack. He used a small steel cup. Scoop by scoop, he filled the jar right up to the brim.
payload.title: Mohan fills the rice jar
decoys: He filled it to the brim

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, two friends share one swing turn count. They count to ten each. Then they swap with a smile.
payload.title: Friends count swing turns

payload.passage: Mishka and her grandmother bought soft cotton wool. The bag was light and fluffy. Grandmother needed it to stuff a small cushion she was sewing at home.
payload.title: They buy soft cotton wool

payload.passage: Esha helped Amma buy a new mat for the door. The shop had mats with flowers. They chose a soft brown one that felt nice under bare feet.
payload.title: They buy a soft door mat

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, Disha shares her tiffin with a friend. Her friend forgot his snack. They eat the puri together.
payload.title: Disha shares her tiffin

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, Ira keeps the class flowers fresh. She changes the water each day. She picks out the dry leaves.
payload.title: Ira keeps the flowers fresh

payload.passage: At the busy school, a friend forgets his hat in the sun. His friend shares her own. They walk in the shade together.
payload.title: A friend shares her hat

payload.passage: While they play together, Inaya brings a basket of figs. She washes them at the tap. She shares them with her friends.
payload.title: Inaya shares her figs

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the class learns a song about the rain. They tap their feet to the beat. They make rain sounds with their hands.
payload.title: A song about the rain

payload.passage: Aryan went to a new farm with his class. He saw goats, hens, and a brown cow. The farmer let him hold a soft yellow chick in his cupped hands.
payload.title: Aryan holds a chick at the farm

payload.passage: Zebras are animals with black and white stripes. They run fast on the wide open grass to stay safe. They live together with many others in a big group.
payload.title: Zebras have black stripes

payload.passage: Ayaan went to a new park with a long rope bridge. It swayed as he crossed. He held the ropes tight and grinned when he reached the other side.
payload.title: Ayaan crosses the rope bridge

payload.passage: Whales are the biggest animals in the whole sea. They live deep down in the cool blue sea water. They swim up to the top now and then to take in fresh air.
payload.title: Whales are huge sea animals

payload.passage: Yash went to a new beach on holiday. The sand was soft and the waves were gentle. He met a boy collecting shells, and they hunted for the prettiest ones.
payload.title: Yash explores a new beach

payload.passage: During the lunch break, two girls find one slice of cake. They want to be fair. They cut it into two equal parts.
payload.title: Friends split a slice of cake

payload.passage: On the Eid festival the cooked food smells lovely. The warm smell fills up the whole house. It makes all of us feel very hungry.
payload.title: On Eid the food smells nice

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, Daksh has a pack of crackers. He opens it at the picnic. He shares them with all his friends.
payload.title: Daksh shares his crackers

payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends share one packet of grapes. They wash them at the tap. They eat them under a tree.

payload.passage: A light shower fell on the new green leaves. Joy walked under the trees with his dog. They smelled the fresh wet earth and listened to the dripping branches.

payload.passage: Hari visited the airport for the first time. He watched the big planes take off. His eyes went wide as one rose into the sky with a loud roar.

payload.passage: The hot sun made the day perfect for swimming. Devraj jumped into the cool pool. He held his breath and touched the bottom, then shot back up with a splash.

payload.passage: During the school hours, Mahi draws a rainbow after the rain. She uses seven bright colours. She shows it to the whole class.
payload.title: Mahi draws a rainbow

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Lalit sees a friend forget his cap. The sun is very hot. Lalit shares his cap on the way back.

payload.passage: A girl named Tara was new at the bus stop. Maya moved over and made room. They sat together on the bus and talked about their favourite cartoons.

payload.passage: Varun went to buy a kite string with his friend. The shop kept big rolls of strong thread. They bought one roll to share for the kite festival.
payload.title: They buy kite string to share

payload.passage: A piglet is the little baby of a pig. It is small and soft and pink in colour. It stays close to its mother on the muddy farm.
payload.title: A baby pig is a piglet

payload.passage: Aditya went to the market for his birthday balloons. The shop had balloons in every colour. He chose red, blue, and gold ones to hang at his party.

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the school has a small fish tank. The children watch the orange fish swim. They feed it tiny bits of food.

payload.passage: On Pongal we thank the cows for their help. We give the cows a nice clean bath. Then we tie little bells on their horns.
payload.title: On Pongal we thank the cows

payload.title: Atharv keeps the class quiet

payload.passage: Pongal is a happy harvest festival for the crops. People cook sweet rice in a new clay pot. They thank the warm sun for the good harvest.
payload.title: Pongal is a harvest festival

payload.passage: Squirrels are quick little animals with a big bushy tail. They run up and down the trees all day long. They store many nuts to eat in the cold days.
payload.title: Squirrels store nuts to eat

payload.passage: The sunny day was made for cycling. Aadhya rode along the canal path. The warm wind rushed past her ears, and ducks scattered as her bell tinkled near.
payload.title: A sunny ride along the canal

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we share with the poor. We give them food and a little money. Helping them makes us feel happy and good inside.
payload.title: On Eid we share with the poor

payload.passage: Dhruvi helped feed the goldfish in the bowl. She sprinkled a tiny pinch of food. The little fish darted up at once and gobbled it from the surface.

payload.passage: Sudden rain caught the children mid-game. They ran for the verandah, laughing. Rohit was the last one in, his hair dripping wet from head to toe.
payload.title: Sudden rain stops the game

payload.passage: In the bright morning, Aria reads a story to the small kids. She shows them the bright pictures. They sit and listen with care.
payload.title: Aria reads to the little ones

payload.passage: Ayaan went to the market to buy magnets for his fridge. The shop had funny ones. He chose a smiling sun and a fat cat to stick up his drawings.

payload.passage: Snow is made of many tiny frozen flakes. Each little flake has its own special shape and pattern. The flakes are soft and white as they fall down.
payload.title: Snow is made of tiny flakes

payload.passage: Mangoes are sweet and juicy fruits that are yellow. They grow up on the leafy branches of the mango tree. We all love to eat them on hot summer days.
payload.title: Mangoes are sweet fruits

payload.title: Reyan shares his cut fruit

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, Suresh feeds the school's pet rabbit. He gives it fresh green leaves. The rabbit hops and nibbles happily.
payload.title: Suresh feeds the school rabbit

payload.passage: The warm sun lit up the whole beach. Ahana built a tall sandcastle near the water. She topped it with shells and a small flag that flapped in the breeze.

payload.passage: While they play together, Anvi brings a bowl of sliced apple. She adds a bit of honey. She shares it with her friend.
payload.title: Anvi shares apple with honey

payload.passage: During the school hours, the class learns about a tailor. The teacher shows a needle and thread. She says the tailor stitches clothes.
payload.title: Learning about a tailor

payload.title: A book about the sea

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, two friends have one box of paints. They put it between them. They share the colours as they draw.

payload.passage: Vikram bought a new ball at the sports shop. He looked at bats and nets too. He chose a bright orange ball that bounced very high on the floor.
payload.title: Vikram buys a bouncy ball

payload.passage: On the Holi festival the colours fly up high. The bright powder floats and spreads in the air. Then it slowly lands down on everyone.

payload.title: An apple is a round fruit

payload.title: Pelicans scoop up fish

payload.passage: Tadpoles are tiny baby animals that live in water. They have a small round body and a long little tail. As they grow up they slowly turn into frogs.
payload.title: Tadpoles grow into frogs

payload.passage: Tara went to a new water park with her family. There were slides and a wave pool. She floated on a big ring and let the gentle waves rock her up and down.
payload.title: Tara visits the water park

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, Aarush has a bag of sweets. He brings it on the last day. He shares it with the whole class.
payload.title: Aarush shares on the last day

payload.passage: People love to dance and have fun at festivals. They put on their brightest and prettiest dresses. They move and clap along to the happy music.
payload.title: People dance at festivals

payload.title: A stormy rainy night

payload.passage: A beehive is the cosy home where bees live. It is full of many tiny six-sided rooms inside. The busy bees store all their sweet honey in the rooms.
payload.title: A beehive is the bees' home

payload.passage: We happily share all our sweets with everyone. We give the tasty sweets to friends and family. We make sure that nobody is left out.
payload.title: We share our sweets with all

payload.title: Nisha brings cookies to a new friend

payload.passage: Sanjay helped Amma wash the big windows. He sprayed and she wiped. The dusty glass turned clear, and warm sunlight poured into the living room once more.
payload.title: Sanjay helps wash the windows

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we boil fresh milk. We watch it rise high up in the new pot. We all shout out with great joy when it boils over.

payload.title: Saanvi buys a sticker sheet

payload.title: Rishi clears up after dinner

payload.passage: On a busy school day, the teacher shows seeds of many kinds. There are big and small ones. The children sort them into groups.
payload.title: Sorting seeds in class

payload.passage: During the lunch break, two girls share one big notebook. One writes on the front, one on the back. They keep it very neat.
payload.title: Friends share a notebook

payload.passage: Dhruv helped Amma in the kitchen. He washed the rice and stirred the pot carefully. When the food was ready, he proudly carried the bowls to the table.

payload.passage: A spider is a little animal that has eight legs. It walks slowly on the wall and across the floor. It spins a thin sticky web to catch its food.
payload.title: A spider has eight legs

payload.passage: Suresh went to the market to buy a new lock. The hardware shop had many keys hanging on hooks. He picked a strong lock with two silver keys.
payload.title: Suresh buys a strong lock

payload.passage: On Eid we love to eat many sweet treats. The older people give money to the happy children. We hug all our friends and family with love.
payload.title: Eid is full of sweet treats

payload.passage: In the bright morning, Aditi keeps her hair neat for school. She ties it with a band. She wears a small clip too.
payload.title: Aditi ties her hair neatly

payload.title: Birds have light bones

payload.passage: A festival is a very sweet and happy time. We get to eat so many tasty sweets. We all feel very happy and full by the end.
payload.title: A festival is a sweet time

payload.passage: At the busy school, Veer has a bag of oranges. He brings them on a hot day. He shares them with his thirsty friends.
payload.title: Veer shares his oranges

payload.passage: Krishiv helped wash the family car. He sprayed the wheels with water. Then he rubbed the doors with a sponge until the whole car gleamed in the sun.
payload.title: Krishiv helps wash the car

payload.title: A wedding has food and dancing

payload.passage: During their free time, Pavan has many storybooks at home. He brings some to lend. His friends borrow and read them with a big smile.
payload.title: Pavan lends his storybooks

payload.passage: Aniket went to the market to buy a notebook for sums. The shop had thick ones. He chose a green book with square pages, perfect for writing neat numbers.
payload.title: Aniket buys a maths notebook

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, the teacher shows a big red ball. She rolls it across the floor. The children take turns to catch it.
payload.title: Rolling a ball in class

payload.title: Om helps wash the scooter

payload.title: Ishaan folds the laundry

payload.passage: Nikhil met a boy at the new sports club. They were both new and a bit nervous. They paired up for the game, and being together made them both feel brave.
payload.title: Nikhil makes a friend at the club

payload.passage: Early in the day, Meena likes her teacher very much. Her teacher tells fun stories and draws on the board. Meena claps when the story ends.

payload.passage: Out in the playground, a friend cannot tie her lace. Her friend kneels to help. She makes a neat bow for her.
payload.title: A friend ties a lace

payload.passage: Aryan went to a shop to buy a new cap. The wall was covered with caps. He chose a blue one with a star to wear on sunny days.
payload.title: Aryan buys a blue cap

payload.title: They buy nails and a hammer
decoys: It was to fix the gate

payload.passage: Rain drummed on the school van roof. Parth wiped a small circle on the glass. Through it he watched the wipers swish quickly back and forth in the heavy rain.

payload.passage: Fish live deep down in the cool water. They swim all day long by moving their thin fins from side to side. They breathe under the water and not in the air like us.
payload.title: Fish live in the water

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, Rina paints a happy face on paper. She uses pink for the cheeks. Then she sticks it on the class wall.
payload.title: Rina paints a happy face

payload.passage: During the lunch break, Misha brings a bowl of cut mango. She adds a pinch of salt. She shares it with her friends.
payload.title: Misha shares salted mango

payload.passage: The clear morning was great for football. Ayaan and his friends ran onto the field. The warm sun dried the dew, and the ball rolled fast on the smooth grass.

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, a friend cannot find his eraser. His friend lends hers. He rubs out the mistake and smiles.
payload.title: A friend lends an eraser

payload.passage: Naveen went to the big city museum with his class. He saw old coins, swords, and a huge dinosaur bone. The dinosaur was the most exciting thing of all.
payload.title: Naveen visits the museum

payload.passage: In the bright morning, Naveen plays in the sand pit at school. He builds a small sand castle. His friends help him add a wall.
payload.title: Naveen builds a sand castle

payload.passage: Reyan went to the market to buy a small mirror. The stall hung many on a board. He chose a round one with a red handle to keep on his shelf.
payload.title: Reyan buys a small mirror

payload.passage: On Holi we love to play in a big group. We run after each other and throw colours. We have so much fun with all our friends.
payload.title: We play in a group on Holi

payload.passage: Our elders give us their blessings on festivals. The older people gently bless all the children. The happy children feel loved and very glad.

payload.title: Sanjay buys a green raincoat

payload.passage: On our birthday our mother bakes a cake for us. The fresh cake smells so lovely and sweet. We can hardly wait to cut it and eat it.
payload.title: Mother bakes a birthday cake

payload.passage: Akash helped wipe the dining table after the meal. He cleared the crumbs with a cloth. Then he straightened the chairs so the room looked tidy again.
payload.title: Akash cleans the dining table

payload.passage: At a party we play many fun little games. The people who win get to take home small prizes. After that we all dance to happy music together.
payload.title: We play games at a party

payload.passage: Yash went to buy seeds for the garden. The packets showed pictures of bright flowers. He chose sunflower and marigold seeds to plant near the gate.
payload.title: Yash buys flower seeds

payload.title: Snails and slugs are soft

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, the school has a small library corner. The shelves are full of bright books. The children sit and read there.
payload.title: The library corner at school

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the children march in the school band. Some play drums and some clap. They walk around the big ground.
payload.title: The school band marches

payload.title: Crocodile eggs lie in warm sand

payload.passage: Anika went to a new aquarium on a school trip. She pressed close to the glass. A big spotted ray glided past slowly, and she gasped at its wide, flat wings.
payload.title: Anika sees a ray at the aquarium

payload.passage: Yuvan helped sweep the back yard. Dry leaves lay scattered everywhere. He swept them into one big pile and scooped them into the bin without dropping any.
payload.title: Yuvan sweeps the back yard

payload.title: Learning time on a clock

payload.passage: We thank our hard-working farmers at harvest time. They work all year to grow the food we eat. We feel very glad and thankful for them.
payload.title: We thank our farmers at harvest

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the class learns about a farm today. The teacher shows a hen and a duck. The children make their sounds.
payload.title: Learning about a farm

payload.passage: The sun was bright and warm at the park. Children ran on the green grass and shouted. Ravi lay on a mat and watched the white clouds float by.
payload.title: A sunny day at the park

payload.passage: Ved helped Amma make the morning toast. He buttered each warm slice. Then he set them on a plate and carried it carefully to the breakfast table.
payload.title: Ved helps make the toast

payload.passage: Avni and her father bought fresh corn from a cart. The man roasted one over hot coals. The smell was so good that they bought three more to take home.
payload.title: They buy roasted corn

payload.passage: Nivaan visited a big toy fair with his uncle. There were stalls everywhere. He tried a spinning top, watched a puppet show, and won a small ball at a game.
payload.title: Nivaan visits the toy fair

payload.passage: Aadhya helped clear the lunch plates. She stacked them up carefully. She carried them to the sink and helped her sister dry them with a soft towel.
payload.title: Aadhya clears the lunch plates

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Sahil brings a box of toffees. He counts one for each friend. He hands them out at lunch.
payload.title: Sahil shares his toffees

payload.passage: A festival is a happy time that is full of love. We hug all our family with warm hearts. We share kind and happy wishes with everyone.
payload.title: A festival is full of love

payload.passage: We light a little lamp at the temple. We stand and pray quietly with our whole family. We feel very calm and good inside our hearts.
payload.title: We light a lamp at the temple

payload.title: Butterflies are pretty insects

payload.passage: We make a big feast for the guests at festivals. We cook many tasty dishes for everyone to enjoy. Then all of us sit and eat together.
payload.title: We make a feast for guests

payload.passage: Eid is a very happy festival for everyone. People wear nice new clothes on this special day. They meet their friends and share many sweets with them.
payload.title: Eid is a happy festival

payload.passage: The afternoon sun beat down at the cricket ground. Esha and her team took a break. They sat in the shade and shared cold water before the next over.
payload.title: A break in the sun at cricket

payload.passage: Early in the day, the teacher shows a big globe to the class. She spins it round and round. The children point to the blue seas.
payload.title: Looking at the class globe

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, two girls share one box of beads. One picks the round ones, one the long ones. They make two pretty strings.
payload.title: Friends share a box of beads

payload.title: A festival lights up the town

payload.title: A birthday card is special

payload.title: Ravi stays close in the crowd

payload.passage: When the day begins, Reena learns a new rhyme today. It is about a twinkling star. She sings it again at home.

payload.title: On Eid we hug everyone

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, Karthik has many marbles to play. He gives some to his friend. Now they both can play the game.

payload.passage: On the sunny holiday, the family went to the zoo. They saw monkeys, deer, and a sleepy bear. Suresh liked the tall giraffe the most of all.

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, Aarya has a bowl of melon balls. She brings it to the party. She shares them with everyone.
payload.title: Aarya shares her melon balls

payload.title: Learning about a baker

payload.title: On Holi everyone is welcome

payload.title: Pooja chooses green cloth

payload.passage: Dhruv helped his mother roll out the dough. She showed him how to use the pin. He pressed gently and made a round, flat circle all by himself.

payload.title: Karthik floats a boat in the rain

payload.title: Amma buys cooking spices

payload.passage: On the green play field, Shanaya has a box of biscuits. She brings it to the picnic. She gives two to each friend.
payload.title: Shanaya shares her biscuits

payload.passage: Clouds float gently high up in the open sky. They are soft and fluffy and look white or grey in colour. Cool rain comes falling down from the dark heavy clouds.
payload.title: Clouds float in the sky

payload.passage: Tisha helped sort the vegetables in the basket. She put the onions in one heap. The potatoes went in another, and the tomatoes she set gently on a soft cloth.
payload.title: Tisha sorts the vegetables

payload.passage: We happily share our joy with others at festivals. We help each other in every little way. It makes us feel like one big happy family.
payload.title: We share joy on festivals

payload.passage: On Diwali we make sweet treats at home. We carefully roll the soft sweets into little balls. Then we happily share them with all our friends.
payload.title: We make sweets at home for Diwali

payload.passage: We light little clay lamps and place them in a row. The small flames glow softly along the wall. The tiny flames seem to dance in the dark.
payload.title: We light diyas in a row

payload.passage: A new boy named Ramesh sat behind Riya in class. He dropped his rubber, and she picked it up. They became friends and shared their tiffin at lunch.
payload.title: Riya befriends the new boy

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, two girls share one box of pins. One uses the red, one the blue. They put it back together.
payload.title: Friends share a box of pins

payload.passage: On the Diwali festival we draw patterns with chalk. We make one big and pretty pattern on the ground. It looks bright and lovely when it is done.
payload.title: We draw patterns on Diwali

payload.passage: During the lunch break, Aadya brings a box of grapes. She splits them into two bowls. She shares one bowl with her friend.
payload.title: Aadya shares a bowl of grapes

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, two friends share one big sheet. One paints a tree, one paints a bird. They make one bright scene.
payload.title: Friends share a big sheet

payload.passage: Joy helped his mother carry the shopping inside. He took the lighter bags. He set them gently on the kitchen counter and started to put the food away.
payload.title: Joy helps put away the food

payload.passage: Shruti bought a pot of honey at the market. The jar was golden and sticky on top. The seller said the bees made it in the hills far away.
payload.title: Shruti buys golden honey
decoys: Bees made it in the hills

payload.passage: Cool rain fell on the warm street. Anika smelled the lovely wet earth. She stood at the door with Amma and took deep, happy breaths of the fresh air.
payload.title: Anika smells the rain

payload.passage: We wear matching clothes as a family on festivals. The whole family ends up looking just the same. Then we all stand together and take a photo.
payload.title: We wear matching clothes on festivals

payload.passage: Caterpillars are small and very hungry little bugs. They eat soft green leaves all day long. Later each one slowly turns into a pretty butterfly.
payload.title: Caterpillars turn into butterflies

payload.passage: The bright sun shone on the morning march. Hriday joined his friends for a jog. The warm light felt nice, and a soft breeze cooled their cheeks as they ran.
payload.title: A sunny morning jog

payload.passage: Our earth has a great deal of water on it. Most of this water is found in the big blue sea. Some of it flows in the rivers and rests in the lakes.
payload.title: Earth has lots of water
decoys: Most water is in the sea

payload.passage: The clear sunny sky made the picnic perfect. Aniket spread the mat under a neem tree. The family ate together while sparrows hopped close, hoping for a few crumbs.
payload.title: A sunny picnic under a tree

payload.passage: On the green play field, Hridaan has a bag of sweets and nuts. He brings it on a trip. He shares it with his friends.
payload.title: Hridaan shares sweets and nuts

payload.passage: Asha bought a new pencil box at the stationery shop. It had two layers and a sliding lid. She filled it with pencils, a rubber, and a sharpener.
payload.title: Asha buys a new pencil box

payload.passage: On Diwali night the whole town is very loud. Bright crackers burst here and there in the sky. The dark sky lights up again and again.
payload.title: Diwali night is loud and bright

payload.passage: Rain made the road shine like glass. Diya rode home in the bus. She wrote her name on the foggy window and watched it slowly fade away.
payload.title: A rainy bus ride home

payload.passage: A new boy named Dev joined the morning football match. Suresh passed to him kindly. Dev missed the first kick but scored the next, and the whole team cheered.
payload.title: Suresh welcomes Dev to football

payload.passage: A new family moved in upstairs. Their son Arjun came down to say hi. Amrita showed him the park nearby, and they played on the slide until evening.
payload.title: Amrita welcomes a new boy

payload.passage: Early in the day, the class learns about a milkman. The teacher shows a milk can. She says he brings milk each morning.
payload.title: Learning about a milkman

payload.passage: The rain fell softly all evening. Anjali sat by the window with a warm drink. She watched the raindrops race down the glass and made tiny patterns.
payload.title: Anjali watches the rain fall

payload.passage: We do many happy things to celebrate Diwali. We wear new clothes and meet all our family. We also eat lots of sweet and tasty treats.
payload.title: We celebrate Diwali with family

payload.passage: Deer are gentle and shy animals of the forest. They have thin legs that help them run very fast from danger. They eat soft green grass and fresh leaves.
payload.title: Deer are gentle forest animals

payload.passage: A kitten is a tiny baby cat. It has soft little paws and big round eyes. It loves to run and chase a ball of soft wool.
payload.title: A kitten is a baby cat

payload.passage: While they play together, Devi has a jar of sweets. She does not eat them all. She shares them with the whole class.
payload.title: Devi shares with the class

payload.passage: A new girl named Priya joined the drawing club. Mahi welcomed her warmly. They sat together, swapped colour pencils, and drew one big picture as a team.
payload.title: Mahi welcomes Priya to the club

payload.passage: During their free time, two friends find one toy car. They do not pull or fight. They roll it to each other in turns.
payload.title: Friends share a toy car

payload.passage: Aniket helped clean the dusty fan blades. He held the stool steady for Appa. The blades came up shiny, and that night the cool air felt much fresher.
payload.title: Aniket helps clean the fan

payload.passage: It poured during the festival fireworks. Disha and her family watched from the balcony. The bright sparks lit up the rain, making the whole sky shimmer and glow.
payload.title: Watching fireworks in the rain

payload.passage: We feel very proud of all our festivals. They show off our happy ways and old customs. We love to share them with all our friends.
payload.title: We feel proud of our festivals

payload.passage: The sunny day was perfect for the garden. Mohan helped water the plants. The bright light made the wet leaves sparkle, and a butterfly came to visit.
payload.title: A sunny day in the garden

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Vedant has a packet of raisins. He opens it at the break. He shares a handful with friends.
payload.title: Vedant shares his raisins

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, two girls share one tin of stars. They glue them on a card. They make it for the teacher.
payload.title: Friends share stars for a card

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we feel very thankful. We thank the warm sun and the falling rain. They both help our crops to grow big.
payload.title: On Pongal we feel thankful

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we make many sweet dishes. The tasty dishes are warm and soft and lovely. We happily give them to all our friends.
payload.title: On Eid we make sweet dishes

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Riya has a big box of crayons. Her friend Sam has only one. Riya shares her crayons so they can both colour.
payload.title: Riya shares her crayons

payload.passage: Early in the day, the class learns about a farmer. The teacher shows a plough and seeds. She says the farmer grows our food.
payload.title: Learning about a farmer

payload.passage: Bees are small but very busy insects. They fly from flower to flower all day long to gather food. They use it to make sweet golden honey for us to eat.
payload.title: Bees are busy and make honey

payload.passage: Big clouds burst into rain over the school field. Sanjay and his friends huddled under the shed. They watched the puddles grow and listened to the steady drumming.
payload.title: Sheltering during a downpour

payload.passage: Aarav and his mother bought ripe oranges. The seller piled them in a bright heap. He gave Aarav one extra orange just for being polite.
payload.title: They buy ripe oranges

payload.passage: Early in the day, Roshni keeps her water bottle in her bag. At break she drinks a big sip. Then she puts the cap back tight.
payload.title: Roshni drinks her water
decoys: The bottle is in her bag

payload.passage: While they play together, Tina has a new ball to play. She asks her friend to join. They throw and catch the ball together.
payload.title: Tina plays with her friend

payload.passage: Peacocks are very pretty birds with a special tail. They have long shiny feathers that are blue and green in colour. They open the feathers wide and high like a big fan.
payload.title: Peacocks are pretty birds

payload.passage: Early in the day, Aman wins the running race at school. He gets a blue ribbon for it. He pins it on his shirt with pride.
payload.title: Aman wins the running race
decoys: He pins it on his shirt

payload.passage: Earthworms are little animals that live in the soil. They wiggle through the ground and make it good for plants. Many hungry birds love to dig them up and eat them.
payload.title: Earthworms live in the soil

payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends share one box of shells. They count them on the desk. They split them into two piles.
payload.title: Friends share a box of shells

payload.passage: Deepa helped her father sort the recycling. She put paper in one bag and bottles in another. The bottles clinked together as she dropped them in one by one.
payload.title: Deepa sorts the recycling

payload.passage: We light a single candle on the birthday cake. The little flame is small but burns very bright. We close our eyes and make a wish on it.
payload.title: We light a candle on the cake

payload.passage: It drizzled gently as Gopal walked home from school. He saw snails come out on the path. He stopped to watch one slowly cross from one side to the other.
payload.title: Gopal watches a snail in the drizzle

payload.passage: On the green play field, Bharat sees a friend with no pencil. He breaks his pencil in two. He gives one half to his friend.
payload.title: Bharat shares his pencil

payload.passage: The sky was clear and blue all day. Bhavna and her brother flew a paper plane. It glided far in the warm air and landed near the garden gate.
payload.title: Flying a paper plane in the sun

payload.passage: Appa took Arjun to the vegetable market. They picked green beans, round tomatoes, and a fat pumpkin. The seller smiled and gave them a free chilli.
payload.title: They buy vegetables together

payload.passage: A festival makes the whole home very busy. We work hard to cook the food and clean up. Many guests come and go all through the day.
payload.title: A festival makes the home busy

payload.passage: Rain dripped from the roof in a long line. Dhruvi held a cup beneath it. She caught the drips one by one and watched the water slowly fill her cup.
payload.title: Dhruvi catches the roof drips

payload.passage: While they play together, two girls share one tin of clips. One picks red, one picks blue. They clip their papers neatly.
payload.title: Friends share a tin of clips

payload.passage: It rained the whole afternoon. Tanvi and her grandmother stayed in and made warm soup. The kitchen smelled lovely while the rain drummed steadily on the roof.
payload.title: Warm soup on a rainy day

payload.passage: Coconut trees are very tall and thin plants. They grow near the sandy beach and the blue sea. Big round coconuts hang in a bunch right at the top.
payload.title: Coconut trees are very tall

payload.passage: It was a clear, sunny day, so the family flew kites. Vikram's red kite went the highest. The wind tugged the string, and everyone cheered as it climbed.
payload.title: Flying kites on a sunny day

payload.passage: On the green play field, two friends share one tin of paint. One paints the sky, one the sea. They make one big sheet.
payload.title: Friends share a tin of paint

payload.passage: During the lunch break, Sara forgets her lunch one day. Her friend Anu shares her rice. They sit and eat from one box.
payload.title: Anu shares her lunch with Sara

payload.passage: On the green play field, a friend feels too hot at play. His friend shares his cool water. He drinks and feels fresh.
payload.title: A friend shares cool water

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, Tisha brings a box of figs. She washes them well. She shares them with her best friend.
payload.title: Tisha shares her figs

payload.passage: On the green play field, a friend trips on the stairs. His friend catches his arm. He helps him stand up slowly.
payload.title: A friend catches a falling boy

payload.passage: When the day begins, Tanvi learns to stand on one leg. The teacher counts to five. Tanvi stays still and does not fall.
payload.title: Tanvi balances on one leg

payload.passage: Devraj went to the market to buy a torch for camping. The shop had big ones. He chose a small green torch that fit neatly in his trouser pocket.
payload.title: Devraj buys a camping torch

payload.passage: Ahana helped wipe the dusty bookshelf. She took each book down gently. She cleaned the wood, then put every book back exactly in its right place.
payload.title: Ahana cleans the bookshelf

payload.passage: The sun was so hot that the children went to the pool. They splashed and floated for hours. Aman learned to put his face in the water without fear.
payload.title: A hot day at the pool

payload.passage: Plants are very useful because they give out fresh air. They make this clean air using sunlight and their green leaves. We breathe in this air, so plants help us live.
payload.title: Plants give us fresh air

payload.passage: On our birthday we play happy music loudly. We dance and twirl around with all our friends. We jump and clap our hands to the beat.
payload.title: We dance on a birthday

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Ridhi brings a plate of cut fruit. She picks out the seeds. She shares the slices with her friends.
payload.title: Ridhi shares seedless fruit

payload.passage: Kabeer went to the market to buy a kite for his cousin. The seller had many shapes. He chose a fish-shaped kite that wiggled its tail in the wind.
payload.title: Kabeer buys a fish kite

payload.passage: Farhan helped his father clean the cycle chain. They wiped off the old grease. Then they added fresh oil, and the wheels spun smoothly and quietly again.
payload.title: They clean the cycle chain

payload.passage: A girl named Lakshmi joined the swimming class. Diya waved to her from the water. They held the float together and kicked their feet, splashing and laughing all around.
payload.title: Diya welcomes Lakshmi to swimming

payload.passage: Heavy rain filled the streets with water. Tejas wore his gumboots and went out. He waded slowly and felt the cool water swirl around his bright red boots.
payload.title: Tejas wades in the rain water

payload.passage: When the day begins, today the children learn to count to ten. They use small red beads. They move one bead for each number.
payload.title: Counting with beads in class

payload.passage: During the lunch break, a friend's pencil tip breaks. His friend lends a sharpener. He sharpens it and says thank you near the school gate.
payload.title: A friend lends a sharpener

payload.passage: A cloud is made of many tiny drops of water. These little drops join together to make bigger drops. When the drops get heavy they fall down as rain.
payload.title: Clouds are made of tiny drops

payload.passage: Ravina helped wash the muddy boots after the rain. She scrubbed off the brown clods. Then she left them by the sunny window to dry before the next day.
payload.title: Ravina washes the muddy boots
decoys: She left them by the window

payload.passage: The class makes a card for the cook. They thank her for the warm food. They draw a big bowl of rice on it.
payload.title: A thank you card for the cook

payload.passage: Aadhya went to the market to buy paper for kites. The stall had thin sheets. She picked red and yellow paper to make two kites with her brother.
payload.title: Aadhya buys paper for kites

payload.passage: Aditi and her grandmother bought a basket of guavas. The fruit was green and firm. Grandmother said they would taste sweet after two more sunny days.
payload.title: They buy a basket of guavas
decoys: They would sweeten in two days

payload.passage: Naina bought a small flute at the market. The seller played a soft tune to show her. Naina tried to blow it and a tiny squeak came out.
payload.title: Naina buys a little flute

payload.passage: It rained hard all morning. Sita put on her boots and yellow raincoat. She jumped in every puddle on the way to her friend's house and giggled.
payload.title: Sita plays in the rain

payload.passage: When the day begins, the morning prayer begins at school. All the children stand in a line. They close their eyes and sing softly.
payload.title: The school morning prayer

payload.passage: A seahorse is a tiny animal that lives in the sea. Its head and body look just like a little horse. It curls its thin tail around a plant to hold on tight.
payload.title: A seahorse lives in the sea

payload.passage: The sun shone on the hilltop. Reena and her family had climbed up since morning. From the top they saw tiny houses and a thin, silver river below.
payload.title: A sunny climb up the hill

payload.passage: On the Holi festival we eat happy festive food. We share the tasty sweet treats with everyone. We feel very full and glad by the end.
payload.title: We eat happy food on Holi

payload.passage: The children went to a busy market by the sea. They saw shells, hats, and toy boats for sale. Each one bought a tiny boat to float later.
payload.title: They buy toy boats by the sea
decoys: The market was by the sea

payload.passage: The sunny day was great for kite flying on the roof. Deepa held the string while her sister ran. Their orange kite climbed higher than all the others.
payload.title: Sisters fly a kite on the roof

payload.passage: Pooja helped wipe down the kitchen counter. She moved the jars aside. She cleaned every spot and then put each jar back exactly where it had been.
payload.title: Pooja cleans the kitchen counter

payload.passage: Akash went to buy crayons for his art class. The box he liked had twenty-four colours. He held it tight and could not wait to draw a big rainbow.
payload.title: Akash buys a box of crayons
decoys: He wanted to draw a rainbow

payload.passage: We light sparklers in our hands at night. The sparklers make many tiny bright stars. We wave them around happily in the dark air.
payload.title: We light sparklers at night

payload.passage: Mira visited a busy bus station with her aunt. Buses came and went with loud horns. She watched people climb on and waved at one bus as it drove off.
payload.title: Mira visits the bus station

payload.passage: Seashells are pretty shells that lie on the beach. They come in many different shapes and lovely colours. Children love to walk along and pick them up.
payload.title: Seashells lie on the beach

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the teacher shows a real coconut in class. She lets the children touch it. They feel the rough brown shell.
payload.title: Touching a coconut in class

payload.passage: Reyansh visited a big stadium with his father. The seats rose high all around. He watched the players run on the green field and cheered with the loud crowd.
payload.title: Reyansh visits the stadium

payload.passage: Polar bears are big animals that live in the cold. They have thick warm fur that is white all over. The thick fur keeps them warm in the icy snow.
payload.title: Polar bears live in the cold

payload.passage: On the Holi festival our grandmother joins in too. She happily throws the bright colours at us. She laughs and plays along with all of us.
payload.title: Grandmother joins in on Holi

payload.passage: Dev helped carry the heavy mat outside to beat the dust. He held one end firmly. He gave it a few good whacks, and a cloud of dust flew off.
payload.title: Dev beats the dust from the mat

payload.passage: During the lunch break, two friends find one red apple. They want to be fair. So they cut it into two halves and eat together.
payload.title: Two friends share an apple

payload.passage: On the Eid festival the streets are very busy. People go out to greet all their friends. The whole town feels happy and full of joy.
payload.title: The streets are busy on Eid

payload.passage: Rain falls down to the ground from grey clouds. It makes the dry brown land wet and turns it fresh and green. Plants drink the rain water and slowly grow up tall.
payload.title: Rain helps plants grow

payload.passage: While they play together, Roopa has a warm shawl in winter. Her friend feels cold. Roopa shares half her shawl with her.
payload.title: Roopa shares her warm shawl

payload.passage: When the day begins, Janu brings a small toy car to school. The wheels go round and round. He shows it to his close friend.
payload.title: Janu's little toy car

payload.passage: We make our home look pretty for the guests. We put fresh flowers all around the rooms. Soon the whole home smells lovely and sweet.
payload.title: We make our home pretty for guests

payload.passage: Leaves are green and grow all over the trees. They make food for the whole plant using light from the sun. In some cold months they turn brown and fall down.
payload.title: Leaves make food for plants

payload.passage: When the day begins, the children learn about colours. The teacher mixes blue and yellow paint. It turns into bright green as the morning goes on.
payload.title: Learning to mix colours

payload.passage: When the day begins, the school has a flag in the yard. Every morning the children salute it. They feel proud of their country.
payload.title: Saluting the school flag
decoys: The flag is in the yard

payload.passage: Ira went to a stall full of colourful beads. She wanted to make a bracelet. She chose pink and silver beads and a thin string to thread them on.
payload.title: Ira buys beads for a bracelet

payload.passage: A girl named Sara was new on the school van. Anjali smiled and made space beside her. They counted red cars out the window all the way to school.
payload.title: Anjali befriends Sara on the van

payload.passage: Rain fell as the school trip bus drove home. Naina wiped the foggy glass with her sleeve. Outside, the wet fields rushed past in a soft green blur.
payload.title: A rainy trip back home

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Navya brings a plate of slices. There is apple and pear. She shares the slices with her friends.
payload.title: Navya shares her fruit slices

payload.passage: Chitra helped Amma sweep under the beds. She used the long broom to reach the back. Out came a lost marble, two coins, and a tiny toy car.
payload.title: Chitra sweeps under the beds

payload.passage: Many seeds float along on the moving wind. Some of them have soft fluffy hair to help them float. They land far away in new soil and grow into plants.
payload.title: Seeds float on the wind

payload.passage: On the green play field, Anu draws a nice card. She gives it to her best friend. The card says, You are my best friend.
payload.title: Anu gives a card to her friend

payload.passage: We light up the whole home with many lamps. We use lots of little lamps all around. They glow brightly in row after row.
payload.title: We light the home with lamps

payload.passage: Eagles are big birds that can fly very high. They have very sharp eyes that help them see clearly. They can spot their food from far away in the sky.
payload.title: Eagles fly very high

payload.passage: High up in the mountains the air is fresh and cold. It is so thin up there that it is hard to breathe. Many animals like goats and bears live on the mountains.
payload.title: Mountains have fresh cold air
decoys: The air is hard to breathe

payload.passage: Vinay visited his cousin's village for the first time. He saw fields, a well, and a big banyan tree. His cousin showed him how to ride the bullock cart.
payload.title: Vinay visits the village

payload.passage: The sunny weather was great for a bike ride. Sameer and his friends rode to the old fort. They climbed the warm stone steps and looked far across the fields.
payload.title: A sunny bike ride to the fort

payload.passage: Sahil helped his mother knead the dough. He pressed and folded it with his small hands. Soon it was soft and smooth, ready for warm, round rotis.
payload.title: Sahil helps make the dough

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, a friend forgets her pencil box. The others give her a pencil. They give her an eraser too.
payload.title: Friends help with school things

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Hema has a plate of fruit. She brings it to the class party. She shares it with everyone.
payload.title: Hema shares fruit at the party

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls find a baby bird. They make a soft nest for it. They keep it safe till its mother comes.
payload.title: Friends help a baby bird

payload.passage: Swans are pretty white birds that live near water. They have a long graceful neck that curves like an S. They glide along smoothly on the calm clear water.
payload.title: Swans are pretty white birds

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, Kiaan keeps the class window clean. He wipes the glass with a cloth. Now the sun shines in clear.
payload.title: Kiaan cleans the window

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, at school the children play in the ground. Some run, some jump, and some play with a ball. They laugh and have fun.
payload.title: Children play in the school ground

payload.passage: Festivals teach us the good habit of sharing. We give things to people who are in need. In this way we slowly learn to be kind.
payload.title: A festival teaches us to share
decoys: We give to those in need

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the teacher gives homework for the weekend. She asks the children to draw a tree. They write the date on top.
payload.title: Homework for the weekend

payload.passage: During the school hours, the teacher shows a sponge and water. She squeezes water out of it. The children watch it soak up more.
payload.title: Playing with a sponge

payload.passage: We hang up strings of pretty lights for a festival. They glow and shine in many bright colours. The whole street looks lovely and bright at night.
payload.title: We hang lights for festivals

payload.passage: Pranav and his sister bought matching raincoats. The shop had bright yellow and green ones. They both picked yellow so they would look the same in the rain.
payload.title: They buy matching raincoats

payload.passage: Maya went to a stall selling colourful kites and pinwheels. The wind spun the pinwheels fast. Maya bought a rainbow pinwheel and held it up to the breeze.
payload.title: Maya buys a rainbow pinwheel
decoys: She held it to the breeze

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls share one box of crayons and chalk. They draw on paper and the board. They make two bright pictures.
payload.title: Friends share crayons and chalk

payload.passage: On the Eid festival the children are very happy. They put on bright and pretty new clothes. They run and play outside with all their friends.
payload.title: On Eid children are happy

payload.passage: Manoj went to the market with his big brother. They bought potatoes, carrots, and a bunch of green leaves. The seller dropped them all in one bag.
payload.title: They buy vegetables for dinner
decoys: It all went in one bag

payload.passage: A girl named Kavya moved to the seat next to Om. He lent her a sharpener. By the end of the day they were drawing in each other's notebooks and giggling.
payload.title: Om makes a new desk friend

payload.passage: Yash helped clear the table after dinner. He stacked the plates carefully. He carried them to the sink without dropping a single one and felt very proud.
payload.title: Yash clears the dinner table
decoys: He carried them to the sink

payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends draw one big picture. One draws the sky, one draws the grass. Together they make a lovely scene.
payload.title: Friends draw a picture together

payload.passage: Amma made a list before going to the market. She wrote rice, sugar, and salt on the paper. At the shop she read the list and bought each thing.
payload.title: Amma shops with a list

payload.passage: The clear sky made it a perfect kite day. Myra ran across the open ground. Her purple kite caught the wind and rose higher with every step she took.
payload.title: Myra flies a kite in the sun

payload.passage: Imran helped Appa plant a row of seeds. He poked small holes in the soft soil. Then he dropped one seed in each hole and patted the earth flat.
payload.title: Imran helps plant seeds

payload.passage: Tanvi went to the train station to travel for the first time. The platform was busy and loud. She held Amma's hand and watched the long train pull in slowly.
payload.title: Tanvi's first train station visit

payload.passage: Riddhi helped Amma buy fresh curry leaves and ginger. The seller weighed them quickly. He wrapped both in paper and gave Riddhi a free sprig of mint.
payload.title: They buy curry leaves and ginger

payload.passage: At the busy school, Mira brings two laddoos in her box. She gives one to her friend. They both eat with a big smile.
payload.title: Mira shares her sweets

payload.passage: A girl named Meena was new at the art class. Karthik shared his paint pot. They mixed blue and yellow to make green and painted a tree side by side.
payload.title: Karthik shares paint with Meena

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the class learns about a doctor. The teacher shows a small toy kit. She says the doctor helps sick people.
payload.title: Learning about a doctor

payload.passage: Mahi helped wash the dishes after lunch. She scrubbed each plate with soap. Her little brother dried them with a towel and stacked them on the rack.
payload.title: Mahi washes the lunch dishes

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, Vivaan keeps the class door open in summer. The cool breeze comes inside. The children feel fresh and happy.
payload.title: Vivaan opens the class door

payload.passage: Myra helped Amma wash the rice for lunch. She swirled it in the bowl. The water turned milky, so she changed it twice until the rice ran clear.
payload.title: Myra washes the rice
decoys: She swirled it in a bowl

payload.passage: When the day begins, today is sports day at school. The children run a fast race. The winner gets a shiny gold medal.
payload.title: Sports day at school

payload.passage: The sun rose over the hill on a clear day. Grandfather took Sara for a walk. They breathed the fresh air and watched birds hop from branch to branch.
payload.title: A morning walk in the sun

payload.passage: Reyan helped tidy the living room before the guests came. He fluffed the cushions. He straightened the table and put the toys away in their big basket.
payload.title: Reyan tidies for the guests

payload.passage: Gentle rain fell over the tea garden. Saira and her family looked out the window. Mist drifted between the bushes, and the whole green hillside looked soft and dreamy.
payload.title: Gentle rain on the tea garden

payload.passage: Aditya helped wash the dog after his muddy walk. He poured warm water and rubbed soap. The dog shook hard, splashing Aditya, and they both ended up wet.
payload.title: Aditya washes the muddy dog

payload.passage: Monkeys love to live high up in the trees. They swing from branch to branch with their long arms and tail. They like to eat sweet bananas with their tiny hands.
payload.title: Monkeys live up in trees

payload.passage: A festival is a lovely day of rest for us. We do not have to go to school that day. Instead we play and have lots of fun.
payload.title: A festival is a day of rest
decoys: We do not go to school

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we wear soft new clothes. The brand new clothes feel very nice on us. We all look very fine and smart in them.
payload.title: On Eid we wear soft new clothes

payload.passage: Early in the day, Saanvi plays the triangle in music class. It makes a soft ting sound. She taps it to the song's beat.
payload.title: Saanvi plays the triangle

payload.passage: Veer helped his grandmother shell the peas. They sat together on the cool floor. He popped each green pod open and let the round peas roll into the bowl.
payload.title: Veer helps shell the peas

payload.passage: A festival always ends with a happy smile. By the end we feel a little tired but glad. We start looking forward to the very next one.
payload.title: A festival ends with a smile

payload.passage: The two friends shared one shopping basket. They put in pens, glue, and coloured paper for their craft. At the counter they each paid for half.
payload.title: Friends shop for craft things

payload.passage: We happily share our food with others at festivals. We feed the hungry people who have less than us. Sharing the food makes them smile with joy.
payload.title: We share our food on festivals

payload.passage: During the lunch break, a friend cannot reach the swing chain. His friend bends it down. He sits and starts to swing.
payload.title: A friend bends the swing chain

payload.passage: While they play together, Veena bakes a small cake. She brings it to her friend. They cut it and eat together out in the playground.
payload.title: Veena shares her cake

payload.passage: Dhruv and Amma bought a new doormat. The shop had mats in many shapes. They picked a round one that said WELCOME in big, friendly letters.
payload.title: They buy a welcome doormat

payload.passage: Leela went to a new playground after moving home. She climbed the rope net carefully. At the top she met a girl her age, and they swung side by side.
payload.title: Leela's new playground friend

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, a friend cannot reach a fallen ball. His friend kicks it back. He catches it with both hands.
payload.title: A friend kicks the ball back

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, Nisha brings a new water bottle to school. It is pink with white dots. She drinks from it after the race.
payload.title: Nisha's new water bottle

payload.passage: A garden is full of pretty bright flowers. Red, yellow and pink ones bloom there in the warm sun. Busy bees and colourful butterflies come to visit the flowers.
payload.title: A garden is full of flowers

payload.passage: A new boy named Veer joined the class. Sanjay smiled and offered to share his book. By break time they were best friends, swapping stickers and laughing together.
payload.title: Sanjay befriends the new boy

payload.passage: Early in the day, Sana watches the rain from the class window. The drops slide down the glass. She watches until the bell rings.
payload.title: Sana watches the rain

payload.passage: The hot sun beat down at the village mela. Sneha bought a cool drink in a glass. She found a shady spot and watched the bright spinning wheel.
payload.title: A hot day at the village fair

payload.passage: Rishi went to the market to buy a slate. The shop had small and big ones. He chose a black slate and a box of chalk to practise his letters.
payload.title: Rishi buys a slate and chalk
decoys: He got a box of chalk

payload.passage: Spiders may look like insects but they are not. All insects have just six legs on their body. But every spider has eight legs to walk on.
payload.title: Spiders are not insects

payload.passage: Lakshmi and her grandmother bought rice from the big shop. The rice sat in tall open sacks. Grandmother let one handful run through her fingers to check it.
payload.title: They buy rice from the shop

payload.passage: Penguins live in faraway places where it is very cold. They have wings but they cannot fly up in the sky. Instead they swim very well in the icy cold sea.
payload.title: Penguins live in cold places

payload.passage: It rained all through the morning match. Suhani and her team waited inside. When the sun broke through at last, they ran out to a field that sparkled.
payload.title: Sun returns after rainy play

payload.passage: Aditya visited his grandfather's farm for the first time. He saw cows, hens, and rows of corn. He learned how to milk a cow with his grandfather's help.
payload.title: Aditya visits the farm
decoys: He learned to milk a cow

payload.passage: Imran went to a new library with his father. The shelves were tall and full of books. A kind helper showed him the picture-book corner with cushions.
payload.title: Imran explores the new library

payload.passage: Riya swept the front step every morning. She pushed the dust into one corner. Then she drew a small flower pattern with chalk to welcome the day.
payload.title: Riya sweeps the front step

payload.passage: Tanvi and Appa bought a new clock for the kitchen. The shop wall was full of ticking clocks. They chose a round one with big, clear numbers.
payload.title: They buy a kitchen clock

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the teacher draws shapes on the board. She makes a circle and a square. The children name each shape.
payload.title: Learning shapes in class

payload.passage: A kid is the little baby of a goat. It can stand and jump about soon after it is born. It stays close beside its mother on the farm.
payload.title: A baby goat is a kid

payload.passage: A puppy is a sweet little baby dog. It is soft and fluffy and likes to play all day. It wags its small tail very fast when it feels happy.
payload.title: A puppy is a baby dog

payload.passage: A foal is the little baby of a horse. It can stand up on its legs soon after it is born. It runs along happily beside its mother in the field.
payload.title: A baby horse is a foal

payload.passage: Ravi went to the market with Amma. They bought red apples, ripe bananas, and a big yellow papaya. Amma put all the fruit in a cloth bag.
payload.title: Ravi buys fruit at the market

payload.passage: We light many little lamps on Diwali night. The small soft flames glow brightly in the dark. They make the whole home feel warm and bright.
payload.title: Lamps glow at Diwali night

payload.passage: Hari bought a new cricket bat with his savings. The shop owner showed him three sizes. Hari swung each one and chose the bat that felt just right.
payload.title: Hari buys a cricket bat

payload.passage: While they play together, a friend cannot reach the swing rope. His friend holds it low for him. He grabs it and sits down.
payload.title: A friend lowers the swing rope

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we say a big thank you. We thank our good land for the crops. We also thank the rain that helped them grow.
payload.title: On Pongal we say thank you

payload.passage: Dhruv joined a new cricket team in the colony. The boys gave him a turn to bat. He hit the ball well, and his new teammates cheered loudly for him.
payload.title: Dhruv joins a cricket team

payload.passage: A baby elephant is called a little calf. It holds on to its mother's tail with its small trunk. It walks along slowly and close behind her.
payload.title: A baby elephant is a calf

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, Rudra keeps the class plant in the sun. He moves the pot to the window. The plant grows tall and green.
payload.title: Rudra gives the plant sun

payload.passage: Rabbits are small animals that move very quick. They have two long ears and a body covered in soft warm fur. They hop away fast to run from any danger near them.
payload.title: Rabbits are quick little animals

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, Vijay raises his hand to ask a doubt. The teacher explains it again slowly. Now Vijay understands the lesson well.
payload.title: Vijay asks his doubt

payload.passage: Pranav helped fill the bird feeder in the garden. He climbed the small stool. He poured in the seeds, and soon two sparrows came to peck and chirp.
payload.title: Pranav fills the bird feeder

payload.passage: The warm sun shone on the school garden. Leela and her class planted little saplings. They gave each one water and hoped it would grow tall and green.
payload.title: Planting saplings in the sun

payload.passage: On Holi we love to play with water. We use bright water guns and fill up balloons. Soon everyone is laughing and gets all wet.
payload.title: We play with water on Holi

payload.passage: Holi is the joyful festival of bright colours. People throw red, green and blue powder on each other. They laugh and run and play happily together.
payload.title: Holi is the festival of colours
decoys: The powder is red and blue

payload.passage: Goats are friendly farm animals that give us milk. Their milk is fresh and very good for our health. We also use the milk to make tasty cheese.
payload.title: Goats give us milk

payload.passage: The bright sun made the river water warm. Krish and his cousins waded in the shallow part. They skipped flat stones and watched them hop across the smooth water.
payload.title: A sunny day by the river

payload.passage: A desert is a wide land that is dry and sandy. There is very little rain that falls there all year. The days are very hot and the nights turn cold.
payload.title: A desert is dry and sandy

payload.passage: A coconut tree gives us so many useful things. We can drink the sweet water from inside the coconut. We can also eat the soft white part inside it.
payload.title: A coconut tree gives us a lot

payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends share one football. They pass it to and fro. They laugh as they play as good friends do.
payload.title: Friends share a football

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls share one box of ribbons. One picks pink, one picks green. They tie pretty bows as good friends do.
payload.title: Friends share their ribbons

payload.passage: When the day begins, Maya keeps her crayons in a tin box. She has red, blue, and green ones. She lets her friend use them too.
payload.title: Maya's box of crayons

payload.passage: Gopal went to the market early to beat the heat. He bought ice for the cold box. He carried it home fast before it could melt in the sun.
payload.title: Gopal buys ice early
decoys: The ice was for a cold box

payload.passage: A chick is the soft little baby of a chicken. It is fluffy and bright yellow all over. It says cheep cheep as it follows its mother around.
payload.title: A baby chicken is a chick

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, Advik keeps the class chalk in a tray. He counts the white sticks. He gives one to the teacher.
payload.title: Advik takes care of the chalk
decoys: The chalk is in a tray
He gives one to the teacher

payload.passage: Kriti helped Amma sort the clean socks. They had got all mixed up. She matched each pair and rolled them into neat little balls for the drawer.
payload.title: Kriti matches the socks

payload.passage: Aman helped Appa carry the shopping bags home. The bags were heavy and full of food. Aman held one in each hand and walked slowly but proudly.
payload.title: Aman carries the shopping home

payload.passage: The biggest room in the museum held a dinosaur skeleton. Its huge bones reached almost to the ceiling. A board explained that dinosaurs lived millions of years ago. Riya stood under the giant bones with her mouth wide open.
payload.title: The Dinosaur at the Museum

payload.passage: Veer went to the market with his mother on Sunday. They bought fresh tomatoes, green spinach, and a bag of onions. The vegetable seller weighed everything on his old scale. Their basket was full and heavy by the time they went home.
payload.title: Buying Vegetables at the Market
decoys: The seller used an old scale.

payload.passage: Hari kept losing the marble game to the older boys. He watched how they aimed and flicked their marbles. Then he practised his aim alone for many days. The next time, Hari won most of the marbles.
payload.title: Hari improves his marble game

payload.passage: Anil and Sunil had a friendly arm wrestling match. Anil was stronger but Sunil was very clever. Sunil used a quick trick to push Anil's arm down. They both laughed and shook hands after the game.
payload.title: Sunil wins arm wrestling with a clever trick
